samples.original: kbtsh82 桂花，属木樨科常绿灌木或乔木，木樨，又作木犀，常见的有丹桂、金桂、银桂、四季桂等。叶对生、革质，花序簇生于叶腋，花期9~10月，果期次年3~4月。木樨开金黄色碎花，极香。为中国十大名花之一。产地属中国，各地种植较多。花簇生于叶腋，花淡黄白色，4裂。核果椭圆形，熟时紫黑色。花芳香，提取芳香
samples.translation: kbtsh82 Osmanthus, belonging to the family Oleaceae, is an evergreen shrub or tree. Also known as "muxi," common varieties include red osmanthus, golden osmanthus, silver osmanthus, and four-season osmanthus. Leaves are opposite and leathery, with flower clusters growing in leaf axils. Flowering period is September to October, fruiting period is March to April of the following year. Osmanthus produces small, golden-yellow flowers with a strong fragrance. It is one of China's top ten famous flowers. Native to China, it is widely cultivated across the country. Flower clusters grow in leaf axils; flowers are pale yellow-white with four lobes. The drupe is elliptical, turning purplish-black when ripe. The flowers are aromatic and used for fragrance extraction.

samples.original: 看的脑壳疼，黑话太多了。尼采批判了早年崇拜对象叔本华和瓦格纳，并将他们当做对跖者，从生理学上对瓦格纳的音乐进行批判。他认为瓦格纳的音乐是藏在理想光环中的虚无主义，是灾难性的蛊惑人心的。拿代表作帕西法尔说，是一部充满险恶复仇的作品，是病态的基督教道德的表现。尼采认为瓦格纳是一个“演员”，其实书中并没有对他作曲层面的批评，尼采还是承认瓦格纳在那个时代是最牛皮作曲家，最多就是提到了“旋律非道德”。瓦格纳在歌剧上的创新，取消宣叙调，咏叹调，合唱等固定套式的段落，用“无终旋律”来取代，还有介乎说与唱之间的“念唱旋律”。但尼采认为瓦格纳中的音乐元素都是不真实的，而是虚无的表演性质。感觉更多的是两个人观念和宗教信仰的分歧。想的太多真的会发疯，所以尼采疯了。
samples.translation: Reading this gives me a headache, too much jargon. Nietzsche criticized his early idols Schopenhauer and Wagner, treating them as antipodes, and critiqued Wagner's music from a physiological perspective. He believed Wagner's music was nihilism hidden in an ideal halo, a disastrous seduction. Taking the representative work Parsifal as an example, it's a work full of sinister revenge, an expression of pathological Christian morality. Nietzsche considered Wagner an "actor"; actually, the book doesn't criticize his composition level—Nietzsche still acknowledged Wagner as the most awesome composer of that era, at most mentioning "melodic immorality." Wagner's innovations in opera, abolishing fixed patterns like recitative, aria, and chorus, replacing them with "endless melody," and the "Sprechgesang" between speaking and singing. But Nietzsche believed the musical elements in Wagner were inauthentic, but rather nihilistic performance. It feels more like a divergence in their ideas and religious beliefs. Thinking too much really can drive one insane, so Nietzsche went mad.

samples.original: 第一次一个人去看病，是在高一的时候。我是藉由着跟家里人说，“我和同学去逛街”偷跑去医院的。第一次自己去医院，手忙脚乱的，挂号、找科室、付费等等都花了老半天。我原以为这一天就可以把我的病看好了，结果医生给我开了张单子，告诉我：“下周一上午来做心脏彩超。”那一瞬间，我慌了。周一是要上课的，我不可能翘课自己偷跑来；既然不是偷偷出来，势必是要告诉父母了。我害怕的是，我父母要知道了，要知道，我一个人来看病。他们会心疼，为什么我不告诉他们，自己一个人偷跑出来。而这，恰恰是我一个人出来的原因。我不想让他们为我担心。毕竟还是个高一的学生，没经历过这样的事情。中午，我出医院后，大脑空空的，也不知道往哪儿走。因为和母亲说了，是和同学出来玩，势必不可能这时候回家的，作息就要做全套。我慌乱地打电话给我最好的朋友，支支吾吾地跟她说，“我今天去医院了，我好像，生病了…”这时候我才恍然意识到，我害怕的，不仅是事情败露，还有对疾病的未知的恐惧。这对于16岁的孩子还是挺难接受的。我一辈子都感谢我那个最好的朋友，她陪伴了我那最忐忑不安的一个下午，尽管我们已经分道扬镳。最后，晚上，我还是和父母坦白了。我哭得稀里哗啦的，父母都以为我是害怕生病，只有我自己知道，我是在内疚，“对不起，让你们担心了。”周一，去医院检查，查出患有先心病。预约专家门诊，复诊，寒假安排了手术，再复诊。我的亲戚们都知道我一个人看病的事，都感叹我是个好懂事的小孩。这是我最不喜欢听到和发生的情况。我为什么不想告诉我父母呢？因为我母亲查出脑瘤，只有两年半的时间了，知道这消息时的我是初三。我真的真的，不想再让她操心了。真的，两年半，不早不晚，她很准时地离开了我。这三年里，我每一个辗转反侧的夜里，都能想起她离开的那个夜晚。而我也将永远忏悔。“对不起，没有好好陪你。”“对不起，让你担心了。”
samples.translation: The first time I went to see a doctor alone was in my first year of high school. I sneaked off to the hospital by telling my family, "I'm going shopping with classmates." It was my first time going to the hospital by myself, and I was all flustered—registering, finding the department, paying, and so on took me ages. I thought I could get my illness treated that same day, but the doctor gave me a slip and said, "Come next Monday morning for an echocardiogram." In that moment, I panicked. Monday was a school day; I couldn't skip class and sneak out again. Since I couldn't go secretly, I would inevitably have to tell my parents. What I feared was that my parents would find out—they would find out that I had gone to see a doctor alone. They would feel heartbroken, wondering why I didn't tell them and instead sneaked out by myself. And that was precisely why I went alone. I didn't want them to worry about me. After all, I was still a first-year high school student and had never experienced anything like this. At noon, after leaving the hospital, my mind went blank, and I didn't know where to go. Since I had told my mom I was out with friends, I couldn't go home at that time—I had to keep up the act. Frantically, I called my best friend and stammered, "I went to the hospital today... I think I'm sick..." It was only then that I suddenly realized what I was afraid of wasn't just being found out, but also the fear of the unknown illness. For a 16-year-old, that was quite hard to accept. I will always be grateful to that best friend of mine, who stayed with me through that most anxious afternoon, even though we have since gone our separate ways. In the end, that evening, I confessed to my parents. I cried uncontrollably. My parents thought I was scared of being sick, but only I knew it was guilt: "I'm sorry for making you worry." On Monday, I went to the hospital for the examination and was diagnosed with congenital heart disease. I scheduled an appointment with a specialist, followed up, had surgery arranged during winter break, and followed up again. My relatives all found out that I had gone to the doctor alone and praised me for being such a sensible child. That was the situation I least wanted to hear about or experience

samples.original: 白斑病是一种病因复杂的皮肤病，很多原因都会导致白癜风疾病，这种疾病一旦患上会给人们的身心造成很大的困扰，那么秋季白癜风患者患病的原因是什么?　　外伤：外伤是白斑病的常见病因，外伤的出现会导致身体局部免疫异常、气血不和，免疫异常会对黑色素细胞造成损害，影响黑色素合成，从而诱发白斑病，白斑病是在气血失和的基础上引起的。除了外伤外，还会对皮肤造成其他刺激如抓挠、摩擦、接触有害化学物质等。　　阳光暴晒：阳光照晒可以促进黑色素合成，使人的皮肤变黑，但在阳光下长期暴晒会使皮肤上出现白斑，诱发白斑病。阳光暴晒会使黑色素细胞功能亢奋，过多的消耗黑色素细胞，使黑色素细胞过早衰亡，使黑色素无法正常合成，从而使人的皮肤上出现白斑。　　精神因素：精神因素也是白斑病的常见病因之一，很多人得白斑病的原因就是因为长期心理压力过大、精神压抑或受到严重刺激所致，各种不良情绪、心理起伏较大都会造成精神内分泌失调，影响免疫功能，从而对黑色素细胞造成损害，诱发白斑病出现。
samples.translation: Vitiligo is a skin disease with complex causes, and many factors can lead to the condition. Once contracted, it can cause significant physical and psychological distress. So, what are the causes of vitiligo in autumn? Trauma: Trauma is a common cause of vitiligo. The occurrence of trauma can lead to local immune abnormalities and imbalance of qi and blood in the body. Immune abnormalities can damage melanocytes, affecting melanin synthesis and thus triggering vitiligo, which is based on an imbalance of qi and blood. In addition to trauma, other skin irritations such as scratching, friction, and exposure to harmful chemicals can also contribute. Sun exposure: Sunlight can promote melanin synthesis, darkening the skin, but prolonged exposure to the sun can cause white patches on the skin and induce vitiligo. Sun exposure can overstimulate melanocytes, excessively depleting them and causing premature aging, which prevents normal melanin synthesis and leads to white patches on the skin. Psychological factors: Psychological factors are also a common cause of vitiligo. Many people develop vitiligo due to long-term excessive psychological stress, depression, or severe emotional shocks. Various negative emotions and significant psychological fluctuations can lead to endocrine imbalances, affect immune function, damage melanocytes, and trigger vitiligo.

samples.translation: I'm full and ready to start loving life, maybe for three or four hours though. I run and run but can't catch up with that version of myself that was once so full of promise. samples.original: 所以，允许自己犯错，允许自己搞砸一些事，接受自己处于并将长期处于迷茫状态，接受自己暂时的穷且平凡，然后带着一颗强大的心脏，不怕失败地往前走吧。       别人的选择看似很好，但不一定适合你；别人的生活很好，但那也不是你焦虑迷茫的理由。每个人都有自己的生活方式，无所谓好坏，仅此而已。        迷茫是常态，却也是动态可变的。你只须接受自己的选择，并且坚持下去。只要你愿意努力做出改变，那些让你糟心的状态都会慢慢好起来。　　更重要的是，生活很少能完美，我们在享受自己选择所带来的好的同时，也必然要接受其中的不够好。        人最怕的不是困难挫折，而是在困难挫折面前顾影自怜。你要有一颗能抵御世事艰难的雄心，而不是过分柔软只会心疼自己。
samples.translation: So, allow yourself to make mistakes, allow yourself to mess some things up, accept that you are and will remain in a state of confusion for a long time, accept your temporary poverty and ordinariness, and then move forward with a strong heart, unafraid of failure. Others' choices may seem good, but they might not suit you; others' lives are good, but that's no reason for your anxiety and confusion. Everyone has their own way of life, with no inherent good or bad, that's all. Confusion is the norm, but it's also dynamic and changeable. You just need to accept your choices and persist. As long as you're willing to work hard to make changes, those distressing states will gradually improve. More importantly, life is rarely perfect; while we enjoy the good that our choices bring, we must also accept the not-so-good aspects. What people fear most is not difficulties or setbacks, but self-pity in the face of them. You need a heart ambitious enough to withstand life's hardships, not one that is overly soft and only feels sorry for itself.
samples.label: depression

samples.translation: Sharing something fresh, the ever-energetic Xiao Liu is here to report! My memo is filled with more and more diary entries and fragments of happiness, waiting for the day I share them with everyone. It's truly a visible daily heartbreak of a working stiff. Recently, meeting up with good friends has been so incredibly joyful; it really feels like friends are the best way to lift one's spirits—I love my friends so much. Chatting, talking, eating together, and hanging out is just immensely happy. The weather has gotten colder lately, everyone remember to wear more clothes. Really gotta stay warm and avoid eating icy-cold foods. I went for moxibustion this week; my body is completely wrecked. Sigh :-( Sisters, pay attention to your diet. Last night, I listened to music in bed and scrolled through all my Weibo posts, looking at friends who commented, sent private messages, and encouraged me, as well as some old friends I used to hang out with. It really feels like time flies. Clicking into their profiles, everyone is living their lives well. That's really great; I'm gradually completing my life's trajectory, bit by bit, and what I pursue is changing too. Everyone is shining in their own lives. Thank you for liking me. And thank myself for being liked by you. I love you all so much, and I love my Weibo "Old Trash Paradise" too. #YuShuxin# #YuShuxin# #vsco# #DailyLife# #MomentsYouFeelLoved# #Food# #Photography# #FoodNotToBeMissed# #Canoe#

samples.original: 四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　想要疾病好得快，那么首先患者对于疾病就需要有更多的认识。白癜风治疗难度很大，长在四肢处白斑更加不好治。肢端型白癜风是白癜风类型中患病率较高，且治疗难度比较复杂的一种。那么，四肢上长了白癜风怎么治疗恢复得快?　　肢端型白癜风治疗不可盲目　　很多患者由于心系病情，很容易被别人钻空子，盲目听信所谓的偏方、特效药。可能在刚开始时，患者可以看到一些效果，但是时间久了，患者就会看到白斑扩散越加严重。因此，建议患者不要盲目使用偏方、药物进行治疗。肢端型白癜风本身治疗难度就比较大，想要治好它，只有靠科学医治才能够解决这一困扰。而不是盲目治疗、胡乱用药，那样只会适得其反。　　面对疾病及时调整好心态康复得更快　　被疾病缠上，相信大家都不会有好心情，但是如果患者们不能及时调整好自己心态的话，那么也会直接影响到病情。据临床表明，因为肢端型白癜风严重影响个人形象，很多病人在治疗时都会十分担忧自身疾病能否得到比较好的治疗，是否可以快速的治好。所以，很多患者也会产生不同程度心理问题。精神状况对于白癜风治疗影响非常大。思想压力大了，对自己身体造成了影响不说，患者还会出现情绪低落到不愿意配合治疗的情况，白癜风的治疗效果会大大降低。　　温馨提示：面对顽疾，靠患者自己或者光靠医生都不能完美地解决这一困扰，想要疾病好得快，除了要有个好医院、好技术以外，患者自身配合度也十分重要。因此，患者一定要积极配合医生治疗，坚持白癜风护理，争取早日恢复健康。
samples.translation: How to treat and recover quickly from vitiligo on the limbs? To recover quickly from the disease, patients first need to have a better understanding of it. Vitiligo is difficult to treat, and white patches on the limbs are even harder to cure. Acral vitiligo is a type with a high prevalence and complex treatment difficulty. So, how can vitiligo on the limbs be treated for a fast recovery? Do not treat acral vitiligo blindly. Many patients, due to their concern about the condition, are easily taken advantage of and blindly believe in so-called folk remedies or miracle drugs. Initially, patients may see some effects, but over time, they will notice the white patches spreading more severely. Therefore, it is recommended that patients avoid blindly using folk remedies or medications for treatment. Acral vitiligo itself is challenging to treat; to cure it, only scientific medical treatment can resolve this issue. Blind treatment or胡乱用药 (haphazard medication) will only backfire. Adjusting mindset promptly leads to faster recovery. Being afflicted by a disease, it's understandable that no one feels good, but if patients cannot adjust their mindset in time, it will directly affect the condition. Clinical observations show that because acral vitiligo severely impacts personal appearance, many patients worry greatly during treatment about whether their disease can be effectively treated and cured quickly. Consequently, many patients also develop varying degrees of psychological issues. Mental state significantly influences vitiligo treatment. Excessive psychological pressure not only affects one's body but can also lead to low mood and unwillingness to cooperate with treatment, greatly reducing the effectiveness of vitiligo treatment. Reminder: Facing a stubborn disease, relying solely on the patient or the doctor cannot perfectly resolve this issue. To recover quickly, besides having a good hospital and technology, the patient's own cooperation is also crucial. Therefore, patients must actively cooperate with doctors, persist in vitiligo care, and strive for an early recovery to health.

Before bed, I still peek at my in-game balance, and upon waking, I'm busy planning the next wave of island design. The happy lives of all the island animals depend on my careful consideration. Wasn't this supposed to be a relaxing retirement game? Also, for example, there's the weekly turnip futures trading in the game—buy on Sunday, sell in the next six days—it's the easiest project to turn into a fortune 😂. Everyone basically looks for the lowest price to buy and the highest to sell. If you buy a lot, you have to continuously travel online to other people's islands, and during the trips, you're super afraid of disconnecting and losing progress (staring intently). One day I tried speculating in turnips, spent hours flying back and forth, made 10 million bells, but my eyes never got a break! I believe many people have similar experiences. Starting Monday, they stare at platforms like Weibo and WeChat looking for suitable prices, then stare while waiting in line, stare during takeoff. Not even blinking, feeling like the moisture in my corneas has evaporated, yet I can still keep my eyes open searching for "intel" 🔎 (dangerous behavior, do not imitate ⚠️). Sure enough, retribution came—my eyes are sore and painful. Lately, I've been using eye drops more and more frequently, but I'm also worried that the preservatives and some ingredients in the drops might increase the burden on my internal organs, and after long-term use, my eyes actually feel like they're getting drier... Coincidentally, a representative from Mengya contacted me asking if I wanted to try their eye care device, with heat therapy and massage functions recommended by ophthalmologists as care methods, so I... happily agreed. Not sure if it's actually useful or if this kind of product is just an IQ tax? You won't say that after using it. Did you know that nearsightedness can still worsen after adulthood? Do you know that excessive eye strain at its most severe can lead to blindness? Do you want to know the secret to earning Animal Crossing bells

The book's content is completely blank, its stark white pages flipping continuously in the wind, the white cloth also swaying gently, only the table remains motionless, silent. A hearse pulling wreaths speeds past, paper flowers on its roof plummet down in the strong wind, a woman reaches out and catches one, telling me it's fragrant. samples.original: 印广法师印广法师大光明藏中谁非谁💐 《法华经》《楞严经》，说尽了宇宙万法来龙去脉－－人怎么来的？佛、菩萨、天、人、鬼、畜怎么来的？山河大地、风云雨雾怎么来的？人我是非、香甜苦辣、种种妄想分别这种意识怎么产生的？明白了万法的来龙去脉，我们再进一步地归纳总结这无量的万法相互之间是什么关系。十方三世到底有几尊佛、几尊菩萨、几个人、几个鬼、几个天、几滴雨、几片风……把这个道理搞明白，当下了生脱死，成分真即佛，永远不落六道轮回；往上不封顶，从住位菩萨到地位菩萨、十地菩萨、等觉菩萨，都可以当下一念就成就，乃至于个别的像龙女那样成为究竟圆满之佛。修圆顿大法，无量劫无量次第之功德可以成就于一生，成就于一时，成就于一念，就看听经闻法的思维观照如何、你的心态如何。而且，即使你是十恶不赦的罪犯，你只要一念明白「如来藏」的道理，如恒河沙数的罪恶一笔勾销；即使地狱境界现前，你可以当下变地狱为佛土，这叫「带业往生」。只要悟了，百分之百、千分之千，一个不漏、一个不卯，这是不可思议的大法呀！#搜孤救孤#法华楞严了义经典
samples.translation: Master Yinguang, Master Yinguang, in the great bright treasury, who is not who? 💐 The Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra exhaustively explain the origins and connections of all phenomena in the universe—how did humans come about? How did Buddhas, bodhisattvas, devas, humans, ghosts, and animals come about? How did mountains, rivers, the earth, wind, clouds, rain, and mist come about? How did consciousness, with its distinctions of self and other, right and wrong, sweet and bitter, and all sorts of delusional thoughts, arise? Once we understand the origins and connections of all phenomena, we further summarize what the relationships are among these countless phenomena. Exactly how many Buddhas, bodhisattvas, humans, ghosts, devas, drops of rain, gusts of wind... exist across the ten directions and three times? Understanding this principle leads to immediate liberation from birth and death, becoming a truly awakened Buddha, forever free from the six realms of rebirth; with no upper limit, from abiding-stage bodhisattvas to ground-stage bodhisattvas, ten-ground bodhisattvas, and equal-enlightenment bodhisattvas, all can achieve realization in a single thought, and even exceptional ones like the Dragon Girl can become completely perfect Buddhas. Cultivating the perfect and sudden great dharma, the merits accumulated over countless eons and stages can be accomplished in one lifetime, in one moment, in one thought—it depends on how one contemplates and reflects while listening to the teachings, and on one's mental attitude. Moreover, even if you are a heinous criminal, simply understanding the principle of the "Tathagata-garbha" in one thought erases sins as numerous as the sands of the Ganges; even if hellish realms appear before you, you can instantly transform hell into a Buddha-land—this is called "rebirth with karmic baggage." Once awakened, one hundred percent, one thousand percent, not a single one is missed or lacking—this is the inconceivable great dharma! #Searching and Saving the Orphan #The Lotus and Shurangama Definitive Sutras

samples.original: 就很害怕，刺探军情让留电话号码，我想了想没有留我自己的，或许是脑子抽抽了，留得之前我爸的号，就算我已经再也不会给这个号码打电话，但是因为qq登录密码一直是他手机号，所以从来也没忘记。但是我大意了，人死之后，手机号一直交着费用也是可以用的吧，毕竟营业厅只看余额。或许号码在哪个亲戚手里吧，我前脚留电话，后脚看见我留的电话给我打电话，惊悚程度可见一斑，电话恐惧症当场发作我必须得承认我的自私和薄情，无论那些和我还有着些微血缘关系的人是要关心还是要询问什么，我始终认可的血亲就是只此一个且已不在人世。而剩下的人留给我的只有梦魇，我也不明白一件屁大点事怎么会成为我的梦魇，但是就是这样。我做重复的梦，很多次，我不想回去，开始挣扎，之后一味得逃，后来就在梦里自我毁灭。这种百分百不问缘由的逃离，或许在我真的决定去死的那一刻也不会变。
samples.translation: I'm just really scared. They were probing for military information and asked for a phone number. I thought about it and didn't give my own. Maybe my brain short-circuited, but I gave my dad's old number instead. Even though I'll never call that number again, I've never forgotten it because it was always his number for QQ login passwords. But I was careless. After someone dies, if you keep paying the fees, the phone number can still be used, right? After all, the service provider only checks the balance. Maybe the number is in some relative's hands. Right after I left the number, I saw a call coming in from that very number. The horror of that moment is hard to describe—my phone phobia instantly flared up. I have to admit my selfishness and coldness. No matter if those people who still share a faint blood tie with me want to show concern or ask something, the only blood relative I truly acknowledge is that one person, and they're no longer in this world. The others have left me with nothing but nightmares. I don't understand how such a trivial matter could become my nightmare, but it just did. I have the same dream repeatedly, many times. I don't want to go back, I start struggling, then I just run away, and later in the dream, I self-destruct. This instinct to flee without asking any questions probably won't change even at the moment I truly decide to die.

samples.original: 聊聊【泡茶】这件事泡茶是茶叶加工工艺的最后一道工序，茶汤入口之前人对茶所做的所有干预，都应算作工艺，泡茶过程会影响茶汤的呈现方式，泡茶可以彰显工艺的优势，也可以调整弥补工艺的一些不足。我们所说的相对完美的茶汤，五味结构，是少酸少苦，多鲜多甘，有辛必然要体现出辛。泡茶手法上思考如何调整各种滋味的呈现。比如酸，高温、久闷、酸重，如果要降低茶汤中的酸则可以降低水温，减少浸泡时间，降低冲击力度。酸味一般在前几泡偏重，这个重酸期过渡之后就可以恢复正常的冲泡手法，逐渐提高水温，延长浸泡时间。比如苦，抱茶量大，慢注水，低注水，久闷，苦重。如果要降低茶汤苦，则可以减少投茶量，相对拉高注水力度，减少浸泡时间，苦重期也在前段，头几泡容易重苦的阶段渡过之后，恢复正常泡法。比如鲜，低温，轻注水，可更大程度保有茶的鲜味，如若是咸，刚前段时间不能久闷，应高温快出汤。比如甘，顺畅注水均匀释放，茶汤饱甘甜。比如辛，务必高温有力度注水激发。可能还有一些需要推敲之处，可能还有用了什么茶器也是有影响的，但思考的角度值得探讨，与同好分享#茶##日常# 厦门·天成花园
samples.translation: Talking about 【brewing tea】 Brewing tea is the final step in tea processing. All interventions made to the tea before the tea soup enters the mouth should be considered part of the craft. The brewing process affects how the tea soup is presented; it can highlight the advantages of the craft and also adjust or compensate for some shortcomings. The relatively perfect tea soup we refer to has a five-flavor structure: less sourness and bitterness, more freshness and sweetness, and if there is pungency, it must be distinctly expressed. In brewing technique, consider how to adjust the presentation of various flavors. For example, sourness: high temperature, long steeping, strong sourness. To reduce sourness in the tea soup, you can lower the water temperature, shorten the steeping time, and reduce the intensity of pouring. Sourness is usually heavier in the first few brews; after this heavy sourness period passes, you can resume normal brewing methods, gradually increasing water temperature and extending steeping time. For example, bitterness: large amount of tea leaves, slow pouring, low pouring, long steeping, strong bitterness. To reduce bitterness in the tea soup, you can reduce the amount of tea leaves, relatively increase the pouring intensity, and shorten the steeping time. The heavy bitterness period is also in the early stage; after getting through the first few brews that tend to be heavily bitter, return to normal brewing. For example, freshness: low temperature, gentle pouring can better preserve the tea's freshness. If it's salty, do not steep for long initially; use high temperature and quick infusion. For example, sweetness: smooth, even pouring releases sweetness fully, making the tea soup rich and sweet. For example, pungency: be sure to use high temperature and forceful pouring to stimulate it. There may still be some points to refine, and the choice of tea ware may also have an impact, but the angle of thinking is worth discussing, sharing with fellow enthusiasts #tea #daily life# Xiamen · Tiancheng Garden

samples.translation: Haven't written a casual journal in a while, let's jot down some recent updates~ Historically heaviest at 106 jin. Lost weight for art exams over a week-plus down to 96 jin. Then, three months prepping for the college entrance exam, eating takeout, snacks, late-night meals daily, plus three months of home-cooked and restaurant summer feasts—six months total—rose to 103 jin. Nearing the start of school, thought to lose some, dropped to 99 jin in a few days. Started school in Xiamen and went on eating sprees, but somehow maybe not eating extremely excessively? Still ate a ton, weirdly, plus walking to class and such (military training basically didn't count since I took sick leave, no training haha lazy method~). Result: by winter break heading back to Shenzhen, weight fell to 98 jin. Home for winter break, ate a lot but couldn't constantly order takeout or binge-eat due to the pandemic (normally at home, besides meals, I'd order multiple takeouts like milk tea, snacks daily—because only binge-eating makes me gain or maintain weight; if eating normally, I keep losing). Stuck at home, couldn't consume high-calorie milk tea, burgers, chicken wings frantically. Though made cakes, barbecues, and feasts at home, it was far from enough. So, post-pandemic, I slimmed to 92 jin, then traveled for two months, still eating lots but maybe due to walking, weight stayed unchanged. Finally, by September, quitting sugar, oil, fried foods for skin care, about two weeks, mostly eating dumplings and other low-sugar foods. Calories were normal, not worried about high-cal, but almost all high-cal foods are sugary/oily, so frustrating. Result: slimmed to 89 jin. After two weeks, weight unchanged, went to Xiamen, quit sugar again for a few days (less strict this time, didn't quit oil/fried), but dropped to 87 jin. Birthday plus holidays, ate feasts, milk tea, junk for over a week, now back to 89 jin. Though I look just fine, not scarily thin, 89 jin still sounds a bit terrifying. Hope zql's recent resumed binge-eating can slowly gain back to over 90 jin!!~ (But what I call binge-eating is just normal eating whatever I want for my appetite). Super easy-to

samples.translation: [ZAF's Lifestyle] What makes professors step down from their pedestals and instantly turn adorably silly? Z's mom's doctoral supervisor, let's call her Grandma S, has been organizing a series of academic seminars titled "Ethics and Mythology in Artistic Creation" since 2012. One session per month counts as class hours, so Z's mom never skips. This month, due to France's second lockdown, in-person sessions aren't possible. Grandma S emailed students for help on using cloud video conferencing. After much hassle, the date was changed from Double Eleven to a weekend, and the time was shifted from afternoon to early morning. Holding a child while eating breakfast and watching a reality show for entertainment: one moment a professor calls Grandma S asking how to join the cloud meeting room; another speaker who's already connected starts talking but we can't hear what he's saying, only his wife using a vacuum cleaner; a usually stern professor appears on camera wearing an apron; and two professors accidentally send a private message to everyone due to shaky hands... Recalling two days ago when @拙石小憨 @克莱尔酱酱酱 attended their friend's online doctoral defense, they were happily toasting with champagne when they were called out for forgetting to turn off their camera, with the doctoral candidate, supervisor, and defense committee all watching. Perhaps the distance between all aloof scholars and experts and being cute is just one cloud meeting room away! #zafinparis #healingandawesome #confusingbehaviorawards #kindoffunny #healingandawesome

samples.original: 。　　总觉得我开始变成了一个尖酸刻薄又讨人厌的人。　　在很久之前，我记得我还是个很有耐心也算得上温柔的人，有人说过我倔，却从来没人说过我脾气不好，就连跟别人闹矛盾我也是温温和和的，几乎不讲一句重话。可是最近，具体就在这一次回家后，我突然就发现自己变得尖酸刻薄又易怒，连之前陪妹妹玩的耐心也几乎半点都不剩。　　我每次生气之后一直会想，到底是她们太过分了还是我反应过激了呢？　　比如那天我们部门的某个小干事因为某些原因少做了一期节目，其他人都几乎没什么反应就只有我内心实在是气愤，极其不友好的凶了他一顿，但其实我在和他聊天的时候已经在很努力的压着脾气，毕竟隔着屏幕我可以把自己的形象维持的温和一点。但是他还是悄悄的提过一声，xx学姐好凶啊。　　在面对别人的时候也许好很多，但是越跟我熟悉的人我就会越不客气，颇有些恃宠而骄的意味。　　但是，是很讨厌的那种恃宠而骄。　　前两天我和一个关系很好的男孩子聊天，他在学校表白墙上看见一张照片发给我，也许是单纯开玩笑的说你要不要试试这个小姑娘说的这个发型，或许是我那会儿本来情绪不高所以我说，不要谢谢。他大约还没察觉到我语气不对所以把这个玩笑继续了下去，然后我就看见他发过来这样一条消息，“而且你头发也不够长。”　　我知道他在开玩笑可我就是控制不住自己生气，然后我回复他，我头发够不够长关你屁事啊。　　怎么看都知道这绝对算不上什么好话，而我说这句话的原因仅仅是因为对方开了个无伤大雅的玩笑。　　莫名其妙的烦躁，莫名其妙的生气，我甚至都没办法好好的跟家人讲几句话。　　但是每次发完脾气又总是很自我唾弃，怎么会有这么讨人厌的人？　　怎么会有这么讨人厌的人呢。
samples.translation: I always feel like I'm becoming a mean, nasty, and unpleasant person. A long time ago, I remember I was a patient and relatively gentle person. Some said I was stubborn, but no one ever said I had a bad temper. Even when I had conflicts with others, I was mild-mannered and hardly ever said anything harsh. But recently, specifically after returning home this time, I suddenly realized I've become mean, nasty, and irritable. I've even lost almost all the patience I used to have when playing with my younger sister. Every time I get angry, I keep wondering: Are they being too much, or am I overreacting? For example, the other day, a junior member in our department missed producing one episode of a program for some reason. Almost everyone else had little reaction, but I was genuinely furious inside and gave him an extremely unfriendly scolding. Actually, while chatting with him, I was trying very hard to suppress my temper—after all, behind a screen, I could maintain a gentler image. But he still quietly mentioned once, "Senior XX is so fierce." Maybe I'm much better when facing others, but the closer someone is to me, the less polite I become, somewhat like taking advantage of their affection. But it's the kind of taking advantage that's really unpleasant. A couple of days ago, I was chatting with a boy I'm very close to. He saw a photo on the school's confession wall and sent it to me, perhaps just joking, saying, "Do you want to try the hairstyle this girl mentioned?" Maybe because I was already in a low mood, I said, "No, thanks." He probably didn't notice my tone was off and continued the joke, and then I saw him send this message: "Besides, your hair isn't long enough." I knew he was joking, but I couldn't control my anger, so I replied, "Whether my hair is long enough is none of your damn business." Anyone can tell that's definitely not a nice thing to say, and I said it just because the other person made a harmless joke. I get inexplicably irritable and angry; I can't even have a proper conversation with my family. But every time I lose my temper, I always feel intense self-loathing: How can there be such an unpleasant person? How can there be such an unpleasant person?

samples.translation: My mom left enough food for a week and hurried back to China. Up until the last moment before leaving, she was stewing pork ribs, making minced meat noodles, soup, wrapping dumplings and wontons, baking my favorite pancakes, watering all the plants at home, and even prepared enough traditional Chinese medicine for two days. My mom is just that kind of person—always considerate of others and incredibly hardworking. I couldn't hold back and cried loudly at the airport; I didn't want to lose composure and worry my mom. Although I'll be returning to China in just over two months, goodbyes always feel so long, and even after going back, I'll have to return here again. Lately, I often recall childhood memories, remembering even the details, sometimes getting lost in them for a long time, and feeling particularly down when I snap out of it—wondering if this is a manifestation of my illness. Recently, I've had severe breast engorgement, and after crying several times since my mom left, it seems my milk supply has decreased... Little troublemaker, I hope you can be good this week and not torment me too much. Your grandma will be here next week, and then I can focus on taking medication and treating my illness. I want to go back to being my carefree self. I can't be a great mom, I just hope to be a happy one.

samples.original: 一个没有梦想的人，是一个不完整的人。让梦想成真，这是实现自身价值的重要途径之一。梦想是经不起犹豫的，在迟迟得不到实际行动的时候，梦想也就破碎了。没有实际行动，就算你有再美好的梦想，再完美的计划，都不过是个幻想。￼有了梦想，就应该为之努力，用实际行动去实现它。而不是坐等天上掉馅饼，等着梦想有朝一日，就自己实现了。在确定好目标以后，总会有那么一些的担忧，害怕过程太长，自己不能够坚持；害怕会失败；害怕太困难，自己不能够做好……正因为这种害怕的心理，在这世界上，能够真正实现自己的梦想的人少之又少。￼实现梦想首先就要“肯做”，然后在这个基础上“坚持做”。实现一个梦想，本来就不是一件容易的事情。没有谁是一步到位的，那些成功人士，在追求梦想的过程之中，总是表现出一种过人的毅力，在此期间，他们失败过很多次，可最终他们不还是成功了吗。著名演员史泰龙在高中的时候，就想要当一名演员。于是他去找那些导演和制片人，想要一个机会。可是整整三年，始终没有一个人看好他，没有人认为他是一个有表演天赋的人。在这三年之中，他从失败中总结了很多经验，终于一个拒绝了他20多次的导演给了他一个机会。正因为这个机会，他成了家喻户晓的明星了。￼你只闻到了他们的香水，却没有看到他们的汗水；你只看到他们光鲜亮丽的外表，却没看到他们遍体鳞伤的身体。梦想就是一场注定孤独的旅行，这路上少不了外界的嘲笑，和各种失败，但那又怎样，只要你脚踏实地的去做，才会离梦想越来越近。#正能量# 六盘水
samples.translation: A person without a dream is an incomplete person. Making dreams come true is one of the important ways to realize one's own value. Dreams cannot withstand hesitation; when they are not followed by actual action for too long, they shatter. Without actual action, no matter how beautiful your dream or how perfect your plan, it is merely a fantasy. Once you have a dream, you should strive for it and realize it through practical action, not sit waiting for a pie to fall from the sky, hoping the dream will fulfill itself one day. After setting a goal, there are always some worries: fear the process is too long and you cannot persevere; fear of failure; fear it is too difficult and you cannot do it well... It is precisely because of this fear that very few people in this world truly realize their dreams. To realize a dream, you must first be "willing to do," and then on that basis, "persist in doing." Realizing a dream is never easy. No one succeeds in one step. Those successful people always demonstrate extraordinary perseverance in the process of pursuing their dreams. During this time, they failed many times, but in the end, didn't they still succeed? The famous actor Sylvester Stallone wanted to become an actor in high school. So he went to directors and producers seeking an opportunity. But for three whole years, no one believed in him; no one thought he had acting talent. During those three years, he learned many lessons from failure, and finally a director who had rejected him over 20 times gave him a chance. Because of that opportunity, he became a household name star. You only smell their perfume, but do not see their sweat; you only see their glamorous appearance, but not their bruised and battered bodies. A dream is a journey destined to be lonely, inevitably accompanied by external ridicule and various failures along the way. But so what? Only by doing things down-to-earth will you get closer and closer to your dream. #PositiveEnergy# Liupanshui

samples.original: #泰国佛牌# 1、什么是一心三藏？空如来藏：就是我们无形无相的真心本来面目。不空如来藏：就是东南西北四维上下、过去现在未来，十方三世，上至诸佛菩萨，下至天人鬼畜，旁及山河大地、花草树木、风云雨雾，一切有形有相的万法。空不空如来藏：我们无形无相的真心本来面目，它本来具足一切万法，这就叫做空不空如来藏；一切有形有相的万法当下就是无形无相的真心本来面目所变现，这就叫做不空空如来藏，也就是空不空如来藏。三个如来藏，当下就是一个东西，也就是十法界的万法，当下就是一个人一个念之所变现，这就叫做一心三藏。2、用对照法观照一心三藏《妙法莲华经》的经题，就是以莲华命名，莲华也叫荷花，莲花之根也就是那个藕，藕切开之后，里面中间一个孔，周边还有八个孔。孔就表‘空如来藏’；藕肉就表‘不空如来藏’；在藕外面看到藕肉，看不到里面的孔，不管你看到看不到，他是不是都在啊，这就叫做空不空如来藏；整个的一只藕就是一心三藏，所以藕是特定表法的，是表我们的真心本来面目的。文殊菩萨在《楞严经》偈颂里讲“顶礼如来藏，无漏不思议”。‘如’就是‘空如来藏’，‘来’就是‘不空如来藏’。我们由性就能见相，所以“空如来藏”当下就是“空不空如来藏”。同样的道理，我们由相见到性，所以这个“不空如来藏”当下就是“不空空如来藏’，也就是“空不空如来藏”。当下就是三个“如来藏”即“一心三藏”。对照《佛说阿弥陀经》。在佛法里‘阿’就是表无相，比喻我们无形无相的真心本来面目，就叫做空如来藏。“弥陀”译成汉语叫“量”，是表无量无边、无穷无尽的万法，就叫做不空如来藏。阿弥陀就是空不空如来藏，所以一心三藏就是“阿弥陀佛”。《心经》里有句话叫“是诸法空相”。“空”表“空如来藏”，“相”表“不空如来藏”，“空相”就叫空不空如来藏。“是”表“空如来藏”，“诸法”表“不空如来藏”，“是诸法”就是“空不空如来藏”。在《法华经》中又提到“一实相印”，“实”表“空如来藏”“相”表“不空如来藏”，“实相”就是“空不空如来藏”。佛法里还讲“理”和“事”。“理”就是表我们"真心本体"，所以“理”表“空如来藏”，“事”表“不空如来藏”，“理事不二”，就是“空不空如来藏”。对照如是我闻，“如”表“空如来藏”，“是”表“不空如来藏”，“我”就表“空不空如来藏”，“闻”就是明白一心三藏。如果讲“一”和“多”，“一”就叫“空如来藏”，“多”就叫“不空如来藏”，“一多无碍”就是“空不空如来藏”。如果讲“权”和“实”，“实”就叫“空如来藏”，“权”就叫“不空如来藏”，“权实不二”就是“空不空如来藏”。“离一切相”就叫“空如来藏”，“即一切法”就叫“不空如来藏”，“离一切相，即一切法”就是“空不空如来藏”。“持无量义”就叫“空如来藏”，“总一切法”就叫“不空如来藏”，“总一切法，持无量义”就是“空不空如来藏”。“槃”就叫“空如来藏”，“涅”就叫“不空如来藏”，“涅槃”就是“空不空如来藏”。“真心”就叫“空如来藏”，“妄心”就叫“不空如来藏”，“妄心往生到真心即往生”就是“空不空如来藏”。3、用拿手好戏来观照一心三藏这个“拳头”表“空如来藏”，“手掌”表“不空如来藏”，“拳头”当下就是“手掌”，叫做“空不空如来藏”。“手掌”当下就是“拳头”，叫做“不空空如来藏”。这个手“拳掌不二”就是表一心三藏。4、用做梦来观照一心三藏这梦中有老爸老妈、同修同事，还有牛马猪羊，还有好人、坏人、强盗、土匪，还有香蕉苹果、桌子板凳、刮风下雨、牛屎狗粪，这一切梦境就叫『不空如来藏』。虽然梦境万千，正在一边打呼噜一边做梦的那个人他如如不动，这就是『空如来藏』。梦人当下就是梦境，这叫做『空不空如来藏』；梦境当下就是梦人，这叫做『不空空如来藏』。『不空空如来藏』就是『空不空如来藏』。『三个如来藏』当下就是『一个念』即一心三藏。我们每一个人都在做梦，每一个人都有那一个念，而且我们不能分开这是我的念，那是你的念，所以尽虚空遍法界、天人鬼畜就是一个念，在佛法里叫『阿赖耶识』,叫『第八识』。我们正在做梦的人那个念叫第七识，第七识是无量，第八识是一，『无量的第七识』就是『一个第八识』，『无量的万法』就是『一个念』，就是『一个阿赖耶识』。梦中的境界，从有情到无情都是这样。 瓦房店市正能量
samples.translation: #Thai Buddhist Amulets# 1. What is One Mind Three Treasuries? Empty Tathagata-garbha: This is our true, formless, and markless original face. Non-empty Tathagata-garbha: This refers to all phenomena with form and marks—the ten directions and three periods (past, present, future), the four cardinal and four intermediate directions, above and below, from Buddhas and Bodhisattvas above to heavenly beings, humans, ghosts, and animals below, as well as mountains, rivers, the earth, flowers, grass, trees, wind, clouds, rain, and mist. Empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha: Our true, formless, and markless original face inherently possesses all phenomena; this is called empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha. All phenomena with form and marks are, in the very moment, manifestations of the true, formless, and markless original face; this is called non-empty-empty Tathagata-garbha, which is also empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha. The three Tathagata-garbhas are, in the very moment, one thing. That is, all phenomena of the ten dharma realms are, in the very moment, manifestations of one mind, one thought. This is called One Mind Three Treasuries. 2. Using comparative methods to contemplate One Mind Three Treasuries The title of the "Lotus Sutra" is named after the lotus flower, also called the water lily. The root of the lotus, the lotus root, when cut open, has one hole in the center and eight holes around it. The holes represent 'Empty Tathagata-garbha'; the lotus root flesh represents 'Non-empty Tathagata-garbha'; seeing the lotus root flesh outside but not the holes inside—whether you see them or not, they are still there—this is called 'Empty-non-empty Tathagata-garbha'. The entire lotus root is One Mind Three Treasuries, so the lotus root specifically symbolizes the dharma, representing our true original face. In the verse of the "Shurangama Sutra," Manjushri Bodhisattva said, "I bow to the Tathagata-garbha, the non-outflowing and inconceivable." 'Thus' (如) is 'Empty Tathagata-garbha', 'Come

samples.translation: #Choi Seung-ri Suffers from Severe Depression# Every time I see or hear news about depression, I truly feel sad and scared. A young girl in the prime of her life was killed bit by bit. Yes, perhaps for her it was a happy thing, but for those who liked and loved her, it is another kind of pain. I can truly understand the despair she once experienced—completely misunderstood and misinterpreted by those who didn’t understand. She hoped to be understood, but the world only seeks momentary gratification. Everyone thinks depression is scary, but I believe what’s truly terrifying are those words that push depression patients step by step toward death—irresponsible, offhand remarks that may not be outright malicious. When you cannot control the other self within your body driving you toward death, the pain is unbearable. When you can only bring sadness to those around you, you feel so guilty, thinking you should die, that you shouldn’t exist in this world. Your disappearance might be a case of “short pain rather than long pain” for everyone. Everyone panics because of depression, but no one ever considers that the disease itself isn’t scary—what’s scary is the uncontrollable human heart. Ma’anshan · Anhui University of Technology East Campus

samples.translation: For the past six years, I often dream of a deceased person, though we haven't seen each other for over a decade. Every so often during these six years, I dream of him. The dreams vary, but I frequently dream of him, almost always with the same feelings: hazy, entangled, longing, yearning. In the dreams, I really want to tell him something, but he always doesn't recognize me, or we miss each other, which always makes me very sad. He was a teacher from my elementary school. I started dreaming of him at some point during fifth or sixth grade, but in reality, I don't think of him at all, and we have no connection—truly like strangers, as we haven't met for over ten years. But now I've been dreaming of him for many years, and I still don't understand why I keep dreaming of him. After each dream, I have to think about whether it was real or a dream, but after a few days, I forget—forget him, forget the dream. Yet, the next time I dream of him, it feels like he's back in my heart. I don't know why this happens, and I don't want to dream of him anymore! It's not that I deliberately seek answers; it's been almost six years of dreaming of him. Xi'an, Gaoling County.

samples.original: 微信朋友圈已很久没有更新了，没有关注我的人，也没有想让看的某人。我在想，三十多岁的我，把日子过得稀碎，很挫败。有时候会埋怨父母一直以来的的批评教育，把我养育的足够自卑，一直认为自己不配得不配爱，说什么做什么都是错的。这是原生家庭带给我的根深蒂固的影响。第一段婚姻像一滩死水，没有生活默契，没有未来期望。图物质？各花各的，产检，生娃，养娃都是自己掏钱。图感情？吵架离家出走，从来不担心不紧张不联系。图脾气好？确实，三脚踹不出一个屁，能把人活活憋死。就这样彼此耗了7年，留给我一套房子一个娃娃。从此甚少联系。第二段婚姻像过山车，原本幸福的生活，未来的憧憬，瞬间崩塌。嫖娼，跟前任纠缠，网赌，打麻将，怀孕一次家暴，往死里朝头部和肚子挥拳头，坐月子一次家暴。说出来可笑，住着我的房子，花着我的钱，辱骂殴打我和大儿子，我还百般迁就讨好他，我可能是脑子有病吧。最后一次家暴，我让他滚出了我的家。传说中二婚，留给我70万的负债一个娃娃。于是，我终于作死成功，把自己作成了负债70万，无业，肥胖，抑郁，带俩娃的单亲老妈子。怪谁？不怪任何人，都怪自己，没有自信没有眼光没有底线没有本事，好吃懒做坐享其成。活该这个结果。为自己的选择负责。我不会做祥林嫂，以后也不会再提原生家庭，更不会再提两次失败的婚姻，此生不会再碰爱情和婚姻。当下，承担责任，抚养好两个孩子，调整自己的心态和生活，努力工作赚钱，踏踏实实的过好自己的日子。
samples.translation: My WeChat Moments haven't been updated for a long time. There's no one paying attention to me, nor anyone specific I want to see it. I'm thinking, in my thirties, I've made a complete mess of my life, and it's very defeating. Sometimes I resent my parents' constant criticism in raising me, which made me sufficiently insecure, always believing I'm undeserving and unworthy of love, feeling that everything I say or do is wrong. This is the deep-rooted influence my family of origin has had on me. My first marriage was like stagnant water—no默契 in life, no expectations for the future. For material gain? We spent our own money separately; prenatal checkups, childbirth, and raising the child were all paid for by myself. For感情? When we argued and I left home, there was never any worry, concern, or contact. For a good temper? True, you couldn't get a word out of him with three kicks; it was enough to suffocate you. We dragged on like this for seven years, leaving me with a house and a child. Since then, we've had little contact. My second marriage was like a roller coaster; what was originally a happy life and future dreams collapsed instantly. Prostitution, entanglement with an ex, online gambling, mahjong, domestic violence once while pregnant—fists aimed at my head and stomach trying to kill me, and domestic violence again during postpartum confinement. It's laughable to say—living in my house, spending my money, verbally abusing and beating me and my eldest son, and yet I still tried in every way to please him. I must have something wrong with my brain. The last time he was violent, I kicked him out of my home. As the saying goes about second marriages, it left me with 700,000 in debt and a child. So, I finally succeeded in ruining myself, turning into a single mother with 700,000 in debt, unemployed, obese, depressed, and raising two kids. Who's to blame? No one but myself—no confidence, no discernment, no底线, no ability, lazy and wanting to enjoy without effort. I deserve this outcome. I take responsibility for my choices. I won't be like Xianglin's Wife; I won't mention my family of origin again in the future, nor will I bring up my two failed marriages. I will never touch love or marriage again in this lifetime. For now

samples.original: 躁郁症有很多时候会想，或许有什么法子是可以解决这些看起来并不严重实际却很要命的问题的，只是还没寻到而已。生活在这个世界上，除非成功了，否则说什么都是个笑话。老人们用一辈子所经历的人生波折来劝慰年轻人：不要太猖狂。但总没人愿意听。过山车并不是最好的比喻，因为从过山车上下来，还能回到原本的生活里，但这些波折，没有回头路。“一点制服不了的小情绪算什么？你只是还没遇到人生的大起大落大灾大难罢了。” 落进这样的圈里，困住的只有自己而已。道理都懂的，就像吃药身体也会免疫一样，排解的法子也会一个又一个失灵。以前爱喝酒，抽烟，爱看些血淋淋的片子，用一切不美好的事情来麻痹自己，这个人间还值得。每回一次重庆，就会证明一次，来来往往，除了看客在看笑话，没有值得。还小的时候，不太懂为什么生活如此艰难，还要不辞辛苦地活着，以为长大了会懂。其实长大了也不会懂，不是问题不在了，而是放弃了。才知道，原来吃糖也还是会苦。

Living in this world, unless you succeed, anything you say is a joke. Old people use a lifetime of life's ups and downs to comfort the young: don't be too arrogant. But no one is ever willing to listen. A roller coaster isn't the best metaphor, because you can get off a roller coaster and return to your original life, but with these ups and downs, there's no turning back. "What's a little uncontrollable emotion? You just haven't encountered life's major rises and falls, disasters and calamities yet." Falling into such a trap, the only one trapped is yourself. I understand the reasoning, just like the body can become immune to medicine, the methods of release also fail one after another. I used to love drinking, smoking, watching bloody movies, using all kinds of unpleasant things to numb myself, thinking this world is still worth it. Every time I return to Chongqing, it proves once again, coming and going, except for onlookers watching the joke, nothing is worth it. When I was young, I didn't quite understand why life is so hard and we still labor tirelessly to live, thinking I'd understand when I grew up. Actually, you don't understand when you grow up either; it's not that the problems are gone, but that you've given up. Only then do I realize that even eating sugar can still be bitter.

samples.translation: Suddenly remembered a cute thing from high school. There was a boy I really liked. One day he changed his hairstyle, and when I texted him, he even sent a preview photo. On the day school started, I was wondering when I'd see him. Then, while queuing in the cafeteria at noon, I turned around and he was right behind me. That boy was already good-looking, and with his new curly hair, he looked especially adorable. I just kept staring at him, completely forgetting I was in the lunch line. Maybe he felt a bit awkward, so he asked me, "Does it look good?" (Honestly, when I saw him, I was completely stunned—how could he be so handsome? I really wanted to reach out and ruffle his hair, cup his face in my hands and squeeze it, then shout, "You're just too cute!") But since I was in the secret crush phase, I could only pretend to be slightly surprised and say, "It's pretty good." (Yet I had a lewd smile on my face, my cheeks were aching...) A few days later, I noticed he had changed his hair back. I don't remember if I asked him why he changed it again; I just figured it was his preference and didn't want to pry. Sometimes I blame my memory for remembering everything, and when I look back, it's always more bitter than sweet—just licking sugar off broken glass.

Hearing this, I thought he was seriously injured and at the hospital, but then she immediately said he was at the crematorium, followed by countless accusations against me that I couldn't make out clearly... No one knows how I got through those days. I couldn't visit others' homes, my heart filled with immense pain and torment. I stayed up for several sleepless nights. My cousin came to keep me company and talk whenever she had time... How I wished my mom were by my side, my family were by my side, but no one appeared before me to help or accompany me. So much helplessness, with no one to talk to. Countless times, I hoped my dear siblings would come visit me. Dad, are you watching from above? Do you see how your family treats me? I know full well they're harassing me over Dad's small inheritance, yet I can't help but link his death to myself. So bitter, who knows? I ask myself over and over, what did I do wrong for everyone to treat me this way? Is it because I'm naive, obedient, and loving toward those who harm me? I don't want to bear this, I don't want to deal with these disputes over interests. Grandma's house was paid for by Dad, but I don't want to fight for it anymore. I just beg heaven to spare me, to not let me have any further dealings with them, to not let me encounter people with surnames like Chen or Pan again. I'm truly poor, but I'm unwilling to fight with them over money anymore.

samples.original: 销我亿劫颠倒想  不历僧祇获法身         这就是讲「华开莲现，即悟即证」！其它方便法中，藏教修无量劫不能明心见性，修通教别教恒河沙数的人难有一个人成就，无量百千万亿劫也难得成就。唯有《法华经》《楞严经》之「一心三藏」，来一个成就一个，来两个成就一双，百分之百，千分之千，万分之万！而且成就高，下可保底不落六道轮回，上不封顶直到十地等觉，乃至像龙女那样成为究竟圆满之佛！就是成就率百分之百，成就的品位高！成就的时间呢，你可以一生成就，也可以一个月成就，也可以一天成就，也可以一时一念成就！所以观照这段经文，就销除我无量劫以来的颠倒妄想啊！有哪些颠倒妄想呢？时间上颠倒：时间上有过去、现在、未来。空间上有颠倒：东南西北上下十方（其实都是一念）。佛法上、世间法上有颠倒：认为什么法门都能成佛。种种的相貌上颠倒：有你、我、他。所以这个「颠倒」呢，我们从时间、空间、佛法、万法之相这四个角度来观照。   这么多颠倒啊，「不历僧祇获法身」呐！不需要经过无量百千万亿年而「获法身」，也就是说我当下就已经见到了法身，获得了法身。圆顿大法这个「获」视同于「证」。圆顿大法只愁悟，不愁证！在见道位所见到的真如与在证道位所证到的真如无二无别，你明心见性的当下就是如如佛。这是讲《楞严经》它的妙用不可思议！过去执着在时间是过去、现在、未来，是不是？那现在明白就是当下一念；过去执着十方虚空无穷大，现在知道都是当下自己一念心；过去认为太阳、月亮、山河大地、树木华草是无情；过去认为牛马猪羊、张三李四都是他，现在知道都是自己一个念，没有哪一法不是哪一法；过去认物为己，认己为物；现在来讲，己也是物，物也是己。大光明中谁非谁？这些颠倒想一颠就颠过来，无始以来的颠倒想当下一念就明白。这叫「一灯能除千年暗，一智能灭万年愚」！        下面的「不历僧祇获法身」是重复解释上面一句话，一念明白过来了，销去颠倒想了，叫「知妄即真，华开莲现，当下成佛」！所以别教菩萨从空出有，在通教禅宗的基础上从空出有，还要修三大阿僧祇劫！三大阿僧祇劫只能证到二行位的菩萨，也叫佛。比圆教佛还要低三十个等级，更何况别教以下，通教、藏教、小乘法更不用谈。可是到了圆教，成分真即佛，乃至到地上菩萨、十地菩萨、等觉菩萨都可以一生成就——一生就是我们这个人一生短短几十年，几十年就能成就，也可以一个月成就，可以一个时辰成就，甚至可以一念就成就，这叫「不历僧祇获法身」。「僧祇」，，是从别教往前讲，就不知道哪个猴年马月才能成就。圆顿大法是无量无量劫的功德，成就于一生一时一念当下，这是不可思议的大法呀！这里的「获」就是「悟」，就是证得。所以有些受方便法影响的人，把这个「获」看成是见道，他把见道和证道分开。对于方便法而言，见道以后要修要证，因为他那种见道还有漏，没有见全，见的是有或者见的是空，或者见的是亦有亦空，都不圆满。那种见道，那种所谓的悟解，必须要解行并重。所以他那种说法把「获」说成见道、悟解，并且还要修、还要证并没有错，因为他见得不圆满。对于圆顿大法，见道即是修道、即是证道。所以圆顿大法「不历修证、不历次第，无修无证，即见即修即证」。       佛在《法华经》《楞严经》就是这么讲啊！摩登伽女是个下九流的坏女人，听佛讲几句话当下证三果罗汉，再听文殊菩萨讲了几句偈颂，当下证四果罗汉；舍利弗和憍陈那听佛讲了一遍苦集灭道，当下证四果罗汉。这还是讲小乘法呀！讲大乘法，八岁的龙女听文殊菩萨讲了《法华经》，当下成为妙觉位的佛—圆满之佛！《法华经》《楞严经》里这样的例子很多啊！无量百千万亿的众生听佛讲一段经、一品经乃至半个小时的开示，当下无量的人成为阿罗汉、辟支佛、住位菩萨、行位菩萨、回向位菩萨、地上菩萨、直至十地、等觉位。印光大师是近代高僧，印光大师一世的精华就是四句话：「法华奥典，妙冠群经，闻即往生，位齐等觉」!《楞严经》从头到尾几乎都是在讲，成佛就是当下的事！当下！
samples.translation: It dispels my countless kalpas of inverted thoughts, without traversing asamkhyeyas one attains the Dharmakaya. This explains "the flower blooms and the lotus appears, awakening is immediate realization"! In other expedient teachings, the Tripitaka teachings practice for immeasurable kalpas yet cannot illuminate the mind and see one's nature; among those practicing the Prajna teachings or the Distinct teachings, as numerous as the sands of the Ganges, it is difficult for even one to achieve attainment; even over countless hundreds of thousands of millions of kalpas, achievement is exceedingly rare. Only the "One Mind, Threefold Truth" of the Lotus Sutra and the Shurangama Sutra ensures that whoever comes achieves attainment—one comes, one achieves; two come, a pair achieves—one hundred percent, one thousand per thousand, ten thousand per ten thousand! Moreover, the attainment is of high grade: at minimum, it guarantees not falling into the six realms of rebirth, and at maximum, it is unbounded, reaching even the ten grounds and equal enlightenment, or like the Dragon Girl, becoming a completely perfect Buddha! That is an achievement rate of one hundred percent and a high grade of attainment! As for the time of achievement, you can achieve in one lifetime, or in one month, or in one day, or even in an instant, in a single thought! Therefore, contemplating this passage of scripture dispels the inverted delusions I have harbored over immeasurable kalpas! What inverted delusions are there? Inversion regarding time: time is seen as past, present, and future. Inversion regarding space: east, west, south, north, up, down, the ten directions (all are actually a single thought). samples.original: 我是真的没想到这个梦直接把我闷醒。昨天在朋友圈看到朋友很喜欢的前任结婚了，我想了一想还是觉得告诉朋友，没等我说出来朋友自己问出来了，她反应真的平静得可怕，我说天啊，我都看着感觉到难受，我真的不敢想这种事情发生到我身上我顶不顶得住。她说还好，真的发生了其实没那么难受。可能是睡之前想什么睡之后就梦什么吧，我梦到我前任连续几天给我发了一些奇奇怪怪的vx，当时挺高兴的，然后突然有一天弹过来了一个视频，视频里是什么呢，他好像去找了他喜欢的女孩子，没有在一起的那种，全程直播表白给我看，说实话，他们很甜，但我看起来未免有些对我太残忍，梦里他没怎么说话，我说挺好的，你要加油。他好像要说点什么，还没来得及听，就醒了。这个梦真实到我醒的时候我都没缓过来是在做梦。醒了到现在十多分钟了，去和刘桑讲了这件事，刘桑说我估计就是生理期加想太多。我到现在就觉得好闷，特别闷，有点窒息的那种感觉。发生在我朋友身上的事情我不知道要怎么直视发生到我身上。但是后来想想也是，我前任比我大这几岁要是结婚了挺正常。就是希望如果真的到这一天了我能平静点。
samples.translation: I really didn't expect this dream to suffocate me awake. Yesterday, I saw on a friend's social media that her beloved ex got married. I thought about it and still felt I should tell her, but before I could say anything, she asked about it herself. Her reaction was terrifyingly calm. I said, "Oh my god, I feel awful just looking at it, I really can't imagine if something like that happened to me, whether I could handle it." She said it's okay, when it really happens, it's actually not that painful. Maybe what you think about before sleeping is what you dream about. I dreamed that my ex sent me some weird messages for several days in a row. I was quite happy at the time, and then suddenly one day, a video popped up. What was in the video? It seemed he went to find a girl he liked—not the kind he was with—and livestreamed the whole confession for me to see. Honestly, they were very sweet, but to me, it seemed somewhat too cruel. In the dream, he didn't say much. I said, "That's great, you should go for it." He seemed to want to say something, but before I could hear it, I woke up. The dream felt so real that when I woke up, I couldn't immediately tell it was a dream. It's been over ten minutes since I woke up. I went and told Liu Sang about this. Liu Sang said I'm probably just overthinking things because of my period. Up until now, I just feel so stifled, really suffocated, almost choking. I don't know how to face it if what happened to my friend happens to me. But thinking about it later, it makes sense; my ex is a few years older than me, so it would be normal if he got married. I just hope that if that day really comes, I can be a bit calmer.
samples.label: depression

samples.original: #小作文# 「回忆＋小说篇」◾以前在崇文上初中最快乐的时候莫过于周五了，熬过上午的四堂课，中午随便吃点饭，然后拿着零花钱去小卖部采购，那种1元一包的小零食，还有每次必买的2.5一袋的三根卤豆干，我那时候还可爱吃怡口莲～满载而归回到教室，下午就可以坐校车回家啦。校车分两个批次，我是第二批，还能在学校里写写作业，半个小时的路程就能到家啦，校车上的车载电视会放电影、MV还有《屌丝男士》，不过由于晕车的缘故我一般都只是望向窗外纯听声音。到家的那一刻是久违的家的感觉，那个小客厅有着和教室里不一样的空气，开电视，拉开抽屉把手机开机，时隔一周回家的喜悦惬意真的太难忘，晚上等妈妈回来一起去另一个屋里看电视聊天吃零食。周一起床实在太痛苦，夜里每醒一次都要看看手机几点了，算一下距离起床还能睡几个小时。冬天上学真的要起好早，四点半起天都是黑乎乎的，回家做最晚的一批车走，上学坐最早的一批车来，我有时候望着漆黑的车窗外还在脑补路边会不会突然冲出来一个白衣女鬼。教室里也是黑乎乎的，人性化的校长允许我们早班车来的可以在教室睡觉，然鹅，大多数的同学们都会利用这宝贵的时间来补作业。◾初中的时候开始看起了小说，当时学校小卖部里有卖一本叫《花火》的小说杂志，里面有很多短篇青春校园小说，在学校里看小说杂志，回到家就在手机上看电子书。那时候可流行霸道总裁、黑道男友、校草文了，但我只喜欢看纯纯的校园爱情，当然还有恐怖小说（哈！我真是与众不同）◾我的第一部手机上自带了掌阅书城APP，一次偶然的机会在上面花了4块钱买了一本《恐怖故事大合集（下卷）》的电子书（天啦噜怎么那时候的电子书还要钱）然后就上瘾了，到现在还记得那篇叫《槐树》的鬼故事，好惊悚。丹丁的小姑家有电脑，每次她用读卡器去下电子书的时候我都会拜托她给我找点恐怖小说，那一次她给我下了一部《冤鬼路五部曲》，是以大学为背景的校园恐怖小说开山之作，这个系列和我以前看过的小说都不一样，它不是单纯的无脑恐怖，它在校园传说的基础上增加了烧脑的推理环环相扣的细节和隐藏的感情线，有一种魔力让你一旦读起来就停不下来。我最喜欢第四部《魂祭》，星晨和林鸢茵，最意难平的一对。作者Tina的文笔我真的太喜欢了，一个字都不愿意跳过，我特意去找了她写过的所有小说，存在单独的文件夹里，可惜她现在不写小说了高中开始看黑色火种的灵异小说，蛮恐怖的，思路比较新颖，不过他交代的规则事宜之类太多了；当然也喜欢悬疑犯罪类小说，雷米的《心理罪》是最喜欢的一本。◾冬天窝在暖暖的被子里，夏天坐在窗台上，听雨声啃着桃子看Tina的小说；暑假吹着风扇靠着墙，吃着豆干喝着水，黑色火种的《地狱公寓》我能看一天；高三在宿舍小床上，开着昏暗的小台灯翻看《心理罪》能找到一本好看的小说真的是人生一大享受。◾配图是以前高中的小本子，正面摘抄反面记录生活（以前还会好好写字，现在的字都进化成草书了）
samples.translation: #ShortEssay# "Memories + Fiction Chapter" ◾ The happiest time in junior high school at Chongwen was Friday. After enduring four morning classes and having a casual lunch, I would take my pocket money to the snack shop to buy things—those small snacks that cost 1 yuan per pack, and the three braised tofu sticks for 2.5 yuan per bag that I always bought. I also loved Eclairs back then. Returning to the classroom with my haul, I could take the school bus home in the afternoon. The school bus had two batches; I was in the second batch, so I could still do homework at school. The half-hour ride home felt quick. The bus TV played movies, music videos, and "Diors Man," but due to motion sickness, I usually just looked out the window and listened. Arriving home brought that long-lost feeling of home—the small living room had air different from the classroom. Turning on the TV, opening the drawer to power on my phone, the joy and comfort of returning home after a week were truly unforgettable. In the evening, I waited for my mom to come back, and we’d watch TV, chat, and eat snacks in another room. Monday mornings were painful; every time I woke up at night, I’d check my phone to see how many hours of sleep I had left before getting up. Going to school in winter meant waking up very early—4:30 a.m., when it was still dark. I’d take the earliest bus to school and the latest bus home. Sometimes, staring out the dark bus window, I’d imagine a female ghost in white suddenly rushing out from the roadside. The classroom was also dark; our considerate principal allowed early bus students to sleep there, but most classmates used that precious time to catch up on homework. ◾ In junior high, I started reading fiction. The school snack shop sold a fiction magazine called "Spark," which contained many short youth campus stories. I’d read the magazine at school and e-books on my phone at home. At the time, domineering CEO stories, gangster boyfriend tales, and school heartthrob novels were popular, but I only liked pure campus romance, and of course, horror fiction (Ha! I was so different). ◾ My first phone came pre-installed with the iReader app. By chance, I spent 4 yuan on an e-book titled "Complete Collection of Horror

samples.original: 我想还是写一段话吧、这已经是我第二次对喜欢的这个城市的一种怀疑了，第一次车子在市公安局斜对面车停马路划线内车窗被砸、时间2017年9🈷️、第二次本月2019年5🈷️16日下午在凉山出入境管理马路划线内停放、是属于职能收费、当我办完事后开车左边车子从后叶子板到前叶子板加前后车门被人用很尖锐的画很深的划痕、当找到收费员理论、结果被告知等公司来解决、后来西昌城投公司外包的智能收费公司片区管理来了报警、西昌市西郊派出所民警赶到现场后要求我和智能公司一同到派出所协商处理、到了派出所片区管理又喊了智能收费的公司两拔人来解决、可没有一个拿出实际的解决方案、都是推卸责任、就连派出所警官都告知对方，你们收费了就意味着你们达成了合同关系理应赔偿损失、可对方公司说让车主去找肇事的人、我一个车主那里去找肇事的人？也是是看到我们是川A的车子、能拖就拖反正他们也不急、也没有敢于承担责任的意愿、我想我自己也可以把我车子恢复如初、但是我还是想通过这样的事情让更多的人对西昌这个城市的管理提出意见、作为外地来游玩的游客本来是很开心的事、结果搞得心寒、其他没有划、就划了外地车牌的车子、我🈶️视频为证，西郊派出所警官很负责、可也没有办法对城投外包的公司处理、我们只有自认倒霉，我真诚的希望当地政府要对这样的外包公司进行监督管理！@央视新闻 @西昌城事 @爱凉山西昌 @成都商报 @封面新闻 @西昌都市报 @西昌公安 四川省·凉山彝族自治州 家驰连锁的微博视频
samples.translation: I think I should write something. This is already the second time I've had doubts about this city I liked. The first time, in September 2017, my car was parked within the marked lines on the street opposite the Municipal Public Security Bureau, and the window was smashed. The second time was on the afternoon of May 16, 2019, in Liangshan. My car was parked within the marked lines on the street near the Exit-Entry Administration, which is a paid parking zone. After I finished my business and returned, I found deep, sharp scratches from the rear fender to the front fender and both doors on the left side of my car. When I argued with the parking attendant, I was told to wait for the company to resolve it. Later, the area manager from the smart parking company outsourced by Xichang City Investment Company arrived and called the police. Officers from Xichang Xijiao Police Station came and asked me and the smart company to go to the police station for negotiation. At the station, the area manager called two groups of people from the smart parking company to resolve the issue, but none offered a practical solution—they all shirked responsibility. Even the police officer told them that since they charged for parking, a contractual relationship was formed, and they should compensate for the damage. But the company said the car owner should find the perpetrator. How am I, as a car owner, supposed to find the perpetrator? Probably because they saw my car had a Sichuan A license plate, they drag their feet since they're in no hurry and have no willingness to take responsibility. I could restore my car to its original condition myself, but I want to use this incident to let more people voice their opinions about the management of Xichang City. As a tourist from out of town, it was supposed to be a happy trip, but it ended up being disheartening. Other cars weren't scratched—only the out-of-town license plate was targeted. I have video evidence. The officers at Xijiao Police Station were very responsible but couldn't do anything about the company outsourced by City Investment. We can only accept our bad luck. I sincerely hope the local government will supervise and manage such outsourced companies! @CCTV News @Xichang City Affairs @Love Liangshan Xichang @Chengdu Business Daily @Cover News @Xichang Metropolitan Daily @Xichang Police Sichuan Province · Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture Jiachi Chain

samples.original: 今天我娃十个月了最近两周都没有更新辅食，也没有好好吃辅食。上周因为跟着奶奶在姨奶家，这周因为外公住院拆腿上的钢板我太累了从来没想过自己会闪婚，虽然是认识了八九年的朋友，也没想过结婚后会那么早要孩子，如果可以，我其实希望再过上一年二人世界再计划，就像《荼靡》里有句台词“我不要我的小孩是意外，不要他是妥协，是包袱，我要他是期待，是希望”但既然你来了妈妈也就做好准备成为一个妈妈，虽然我一直嚷嚷着我还没有玩够，还没有享受够自由从怀孕到你降生，妈妈也是满怀期待，去看去找去准备知识和物品，我认为我也是做好万全准备但事实上我还是手忙脚乱的，尤其是生完你后的这十个月，无力感一直存在。花自己的钱买奶粉买纸尿裤买玩具都要一一报备，好像以前那个风风火火，干脆利索的我不存在了，任性固执的我也不见了，我开始变的妥协，不断的理解，自我开解，这些都被总结为母爱大放光辉光辉，真的是这样么前年我爸受伤住院，躺在床上起不来我都没觉得这么累，今年仅仅小手术，我却觉得更累手术结束，我既要抱你又要推床，往返医院安全座椅哭闹不坐，挣扎着拽着我头发要来我怀里，没办法我只能骑摩托车，又担心你在医院抵抗力差把你留在家里，给你还不到12岁的舅舅看，送饭回来听他讲你找不到我哭的多惨前天午休，在床上看你玩着玩着我睡着了结果你掉床了，还好没摔倒哪里，把我心疼坏了，今晚在姨奶家，你又从沙发上摔了下去额头磕个包，妈妈心都要碎了，一闭眼就是你一遍一遍的摔下沙发，实在睡不下起来写写我要改变，为了你我也不会再妥协忍让了，以后我们过有质量的生活，不需要考虑太多，你有权利享受妈妈给予你的爱，妈妈也仅仅希望你衣食无忧，快乐健康成长，在爱，满足，包容，勇气中成长，十个月快乐王肉肉小盆友！（图为我回家做饭，回来我弟自豪的告诉我他自己晃悠了20多分钟哄睡的）我弟长大了
samples.translation: My baby is ten months old today. I haven't updated about solid foods in the past two weeks, and he hasn't been eating them well either. Last week was because we were at my aunt's with grandma, and this week I'm exhausted because grandpa was hospitalized to have the steel plate in his leg removed. I never thought I'd have a whirlwind marriage, even though we were friends for eight or nine years, and I never thought we'd have a child so soon after marrying. If possible, I actually wished for another year of just the two of us before planning, like a line from the drama "Life Plan A and B": "I don't want my child to be an accident, a compromise, a burden. I want him to be an expectation, a hope." But since you came, Mom prepared herself to become a mother. Even though I kept saying I hadn't played enough, hadn't enjoyed enough freedom, from pregnancy to your birth, I was also full of anticipation, seeking out knowledge and preparing items. I thought I was fully prepared, but in reality, I've been scrambling, especially these past ten months since you were born. A sense of helplessness has been constant. Spending my own money on formula, diapers, toys requires reporting every item, as if the decisive, efficient me from before no longer exists. The willful, stubborn me is gone too. I've started to compromise, constantly understanding, consoling myself. All this gets summed up as maternal love shining brightly. Is it really like that? The year before last when my dad was injured and hospitalized, bedridden, I didn't feel this tired. This year, even with a minor surgery, I feel more exhausted. After the surgery, I had to hold you while pushing the bed. You cried and refused the car seat back and forth to the hospital, struggling, pulling my hair, wanting to be in my arms. I had no choice but to ride the motorcycle. I worried about your weaker immunity at the hospital, so I left you at home with your uncle who's not even 12 yet. Coming back from delivering food, I heard him describe how miserably you cried when you couldn't find me. The day before yesterday during a nap, I fell asleep watching you play on the bed, and you fell off. Luckily you didn't get hurt, but it broke my heart. Tonight at my aunt's, you fell off the sofa again and got a bump on your forehead. Mom

samples.original: #美妆必buy品#油痘肌成分党的修复＋护肤秘诀！ 变成了研究僧，需要长时间埋在实验室里，可能压力太大了，痘痘经常爆发😭就算消下去了还有痘印存在！精致的女孩，不仅要科研做的6，护肤更是不能停！（如果皮肤状态不好，我就会一整天兴致都不高😭）因为是用在脸上的，所以也是发挥了研究生的精神，从品牌、成分到使用效果，严格把关，最终脱颖而出的强大胜利者哦，修复能力很nice的创尔美修护面膜和小魔瓶‼️其实我是看到吉克隽逸，我女神的同款‼️才下定决心买的，哈哈哈面膜的话，我一般是在晚上用，它的主要成分很简单，就是水和胶原，也没有其他添加剂，对敏感肌肤是很友好的。而且因为没添加增稠剂，它的精华就很稀。这个品牌的生产标准都是按GMP来的，再加上它有经过特殊辐照处理的，可以直接敷贴在受损肌肤上，和平常的面膜不一样！就算长痘痘了，也敢大胆放心的敷啦~为了避免拿出来面膜时，精华液流出，我每次都先捏一捏，把多余的精华液先挤到袋里！然后敷了一会，感觉吸收差不多了，再把袋里剩余的精华涂抹上去，所以它的使用时间要长点，需要敷个20分钟。我虽然是油皮，但是仍然觉得敷完以后特别清爽❗️它都不需要清洗的，可以直接涂抹水乳，很省事啊！嘻嘻…⚠️友情提示：现在秋冬季节，皮肤偏干，做完面膜之后，一定要再进行正常护肤顺序，擦上水、精华、乳、面霜等护肤品，这样才能把水份锁进皮肤~达到长效的保湿功能~💕水乳可以选择呼吸，我说过很多次，很nice～虽然现在是秋天，但是美白防晒还是不能停‼️今天宋轶小姐姐因为白还上了热搜～⚠️不管春夏秋冬，阴雨晴天，都要擦隔离防晒霜！！！紫外线强的时候还要穿防晒衣，带遮阳伞~ 充分做好物理防晒另外像我很喜欢吃含VC食物~比如小黄瓜、西红柿等~食物所含的VC也能有效帮助黑色素还原，帮助人体维持白皙状态~我在买面膜的时候还加了它家的小魔瓶修护原液，想把下巴的暗沉给救回来～淡化痘印。小魔瓶我一般是晚上敷完面膜以后再滴在脸上，来帮助吸收后续的产品。面膜我用了2盒了，现在脸上的痘已经不是很严重了，不细看几乎看不出来了～🙈看着比以前舒服了好多。总之，希望秋冬你萌一样也很美💕 绿洲 #潮流种草季#

samples.translation: Often, I don't understand myself either. I'm clearly the type who can take any joke, yet sometimes I get hung up for days over a particularly insignificant remark. I'm clearly not the type who loves to nitpick, but I do indeed fixate on a very, very small thing, leading to broken relationships. I think I'm a person with very firm willpower and a pretty good mindset, yet I can also be swayed by others' doubts, by their few casual words. I clearly know that saying certain things will hurt others, but I still say them; I clearly know I'll regret doing this, but I still do it. To be honest, I've had enough of this kind of life, seen enough of this version of myself. There's no other way; besides toughing it out, there's no choice. Toughing it out through suddenly becoming fragile, suddenly becoming unhappy, suddenly being caught by some detail, suddenly falling into that silence where I don't want to speak, putting everything into memories, letting time grind them into water placed in my heart, only to flow out from my eyes. This is my strongest point, and also my weakest point... Depression #TakeAPictureWithTheFrame# #WeatherIsDestiny#

I want to have money—not necessarily a lot, but I don’t want to live in this kind of environment, where I have nothing and can do nothing, where even effort feels powerless, where nothing changes, and I just go with the flow. I really envy those who either come from wealthy families or have the ability, not from a family where my mother left when I was six and my father stayed home for over ten years without working, lazy and gluttonous. samples.original: 奶柚无敌#毕竟是柚子同人文# 【小白X柚子】你一根我一根，咦，怎么只有一根辣条了？（一）        想写狗柚子的同人文好久了，这篇文是块小甜饼呀。请大家多多支持呀！不定期更新，看我心情，不过应该是个小短篇，白柚大军，给我站起来！！！ 文案：电竞文，ABO设定 最强阿珂柚子X国服韩信小白 并不王者的王者文。前方注意！十分沙雕。         柚子是这两年在斗鱼直播上凭借一手戳屁股能手的刺客阿珂爆红的王者荣耀主播，也是现在活跃在一线的主播中少有的omega。        王者荣耀是最近比较热门的一款团队竞技类游戏，在游戏中，柚子主要操作的是打野这个位置的英雄。第一次直播柚子打的是雅典娜，是个死亡后在峡谷上空飘着盯着队友，给队友增加鸭梨的英雄，对于操作的要求还是蛮高的，需要满脑子的献祭想法。        简直是玛丽苏男主的标配好嘛，我弄不死你我就去死！        柚子并不是职业玩家出身，简单点说吧，职业队里的教练嫌他吃太多了，把他扔出来了，所以没上的了职业战场。第一次直播他的水平其实在其他主播看来不算好，还需要再磨练一下，但是长得又圆，又有说垃圾话的天赋，比如，小老弟，你怎么肥似，天生就是吃这碗饭的料。       一张圆润的脸庞怼着镜头，小小的眼睛紧紧盯着你，话都不用说，小姐姐们就都忍不住捂住心口开始大声嚎哭：胖柚子！！！木由子！！！爸爸爱你！！！        第一次直播后，柚子被一个浑身发着闪光的小戴姐姐看上，参加了一场由斗鱼举办的DSF比赛，只能在斗鱼直播上看见的小比赛。比赛里，他担任的是ADC的位置，传说中的太阳落山了的后裔。        凭借这场比赛，柚子也被斗鱼发现了稍许的潜力，虽然不算一飞冲天但也能说算是主播途坦荡？了。        柚子本来是传媒大学新闻系的学生，结果还没等他开始做新闻，自己先变成新闻了。        因为前几次的游戏直播的人设都比较逗比，不过还有出彩的部分，比如说拿刺客打野，恰好柚子最近找到了一个适合他的戳屁股的英雄——阿珂，按狗柚子的话来说，从背后戳，百分百暴击的最适合他这个脸黑的人了，所以经济公司就干脆给他艹了一个最强戳屁股能手的人设。柚子自己都觉得这狗屁人设实在过分沙雕，但是，生活不易，忍了。        不知道现在的小姑娘是梦回一九八八还是怎么的，这种走沙雕路线穿品如衣服的人设，竟然从一群小奶狗小狼狗老干部中脱颖而出，意外的吃香。        柚子不太爱在社交软件上说话，所以他的微博大部分时间都不是自己打理。如果他的原创微博出现了“爱你们~”一类的字样，还配上了自拍，那多半是经纪人姐姐又上线了。评论区里都是一水的：小戴姐姐辛苦了！经纪人姐姐又帮忙来发微博了！小戴姐姐以后能悄悄拍一下狗柚子的胖脸凑个九宫格吗？好久不见了，甚是想念。        但是如果只有一句“钵钵鸡们，我来了”这几个字，粉丝们就知道是柚子上线了。        柚子自己也不知道为什么他比那些Alpha主播更圈粉，自己在老爹老娘面前就是三棍子，不五棍子打不出来一个闷屁的性格。         每次参加斗鱼举办的活动的时候都是假笑的站在那里神游，被其他人提醒后才反应过来应两句：嗯嗯嗯，对对对，就是这样，你说的太棒了！后来一度被钵钵鸡们嘲笑是在幻想自己是阿珂疯狂想戳主持人嗯嗯。         其实他内心没有这么污的，他只是不知道在台上干什么，放不开。然后得了一个活动黑人的标签。归根结底，大概是他这个大脸盘子甚是让小姐姐们喜爱的缘故吧。

samples.translation: While browsing Bilibili, I saw an interview with Zu'e: "What's your view on marketing accounts?" "They're just trying to survive, they have to write whatever gets attention, we should understand each other." Clarification posts get comments from people posing as casual onlookers saying "stop whitewashing," and I'm like: ????? What is whitewashing? Marketing accounts spread dirt to make money, writing malicious articles fabricating things out of thin air—out of so many professions, they choose this one, using just a few words to drag others into a whirlpool of public opinion. The helplessness of doing it for a living—that's what deserves whitewashing!! Liking someone who has a boyfriend/girlfriend, a family, kids, being a homewrecker who intrudes on others' relationships, justifying it with "just because I like them"—that's whitewashing!! Nowadays, people join online mobs and call themselves "snowflakes bravely charging ahead," turn on idols they used to fan or act as fair-weather critics with hindsight like "time-traveling police" saying "he's actually that kind of person"—why give yourselves such nice labels when your words are so filthy.... And those demanding apologies.... Why should people apologize for things they didn't do? Even if they apologize, would those mouths ever shut? Some people are just too idle. The malice of marketing accounts is disgusting.

samples.translation: Recently I dug out the letter my mom wrote to me on my 18th birthday in 2018. I had gone out drinking that day and came back drunk, so I didn’t read it until the next day. Back then, I thought my mom was just complaining about me being unfocused or something—she used to say that a lot, so I was really sensitive about it. But now, reading it again, that feeling is gone. Two years have passed in a blink, and I’ve grown up a bit more. I feel my mom has become more tolerant toward me, maybe because she thinks I won’t be by her side much longer. And here I am, carefree, still asking her every day to help me find a boyfriend! I’ve also changed a lot toward her—I never let arguments linger overnight anymore! I’m rambling so much! samples.original: 这是南淮城边的小铺子，靠近富商褚氏的林场，外面是一眼望不尽的松杉林。伐木的劳力每天回城都从小道边过，于是有了这样一个简陋的小铺子。夜深，铺子里只剩下最后一桌客人，没有一个人说话，静得发寒。 　　雪地上点着无数的火盆，照得周围一片通明，人影交叠，不知道多少人围在帐篷周围。看见这一幕，他们全部惊恐地跪了下去，巴夯也跪下。只有老人昂然地站在人群中央，一手扯着儿子，一手提着重剑，抬起头去看天空。 　　最近我的日子过得很糊涂，一直记不清是哪一天要演讲，直到前天有位朋友打电话给我说∶我们后天在耕莘文教院见　　“谁？”　　“警察局长的大儿子　　“是缅因州吗？”她笑著说#读书微盘点##品质阅读#
samples.translation: This is a small shop on the outskirts of Nanhuai City, near the timber forest owned by the wealthy merchant Chu. Outside lies an endless expanse of pine and fir woods. Logging laborers pass by the path daily on their way back to the city, hence this simple shop came to be. Late at night, only one table of customers remains in the shop; no one speaks, and the silence is chilling. Countless braziers light up the snowy ground, illuminating the surroundings brightly, with overlapping shadows—countless people surround the tent. Seeing this scene, they all kneel in terror, Ba Hang also kneels. Only the old man stands proudly at the center of the crowd, one hand pulling his son, the other holding a heavy sword, looking up at the sky. Lately, my days have been muddled; I keep forgetting which day the speech is scheduled, until a friend called me the day before yesterday and said: "We'll meet at Gengxin Cultural and Educational Center the day after tomorrow." "Who?" "The police chief's eldest son." "Is it in Maine?" she said with a laugh. #ReadingMicroRoundup# #QualityReading#

The two poems printed on the cover are his timeless masterpieces: one is "The night gives me black eyes, yet I use them to seek light," and the other is "You, now looking at me, now at the clouds. samples.original: #我们之间的盐# 最近废话好多，倾诉欲饱和，主要是太无聊了。于是我决定以后就在这条下面逼逼叨叨，这样也不会让大嘎觉得太烦。五月碎碎念收集：1. 我进步了！以前：一天不干点正事就会拼命自责。现在：哈哈！我就是废物！2. 2020了张纪闻和陈诗卉到底什么时候领证，无语子，我狗叫了三年（？）都烦了！3. 昨天看了82年的老片子《城南旧事》，我太喜欢了！林海音的这本原著和曹文轩的所有小说是我童年时期文学启蒙，我真的看了大概有10遍吧。btw每天一部电影就是我的理想生活，喝什么奶茶，不吃饭也可以（其实不可以）。4. Take the bunny and run～/想过离开～我最近两天睡觉都在颅内蹦迪唱这两句，救命！5. 我爱夏天，即使我时刻都想爬进冰箱，即使我一晚上能被咬三十个蚊子包。但是夏天的午后真的很美好！“太阳强烈，水波温柔”，加之蝉鸣噪杂，风扇絮语，或者一下雨就轰隆隆，泥土气扑面而来，让我这种天天怀疑自己是否真实存在的人feel alive。仔细想想，生命中重要的人也都是在夏天遇见的。6. 想  吃  烤  肉  。有什么办法能让我不想吗？如有，请私戳马云领取感恩红包。7. 研究了一下地图，发现去上海以后每天上下班要步行至少30分钟，这意味着不敢骑小黄车的我即将免费收获一轮美黑！我的胆量真的跟尬点一样奇怪：敢开车，但不敢骑车上街，看到汽车经过就“我好怕！”，下一秒就跳车。8. 每天都在yy：什么时候能养狗子啊，什么时候家里有按摩椅啊，什么时候房间里出现一只比我人还高的泰迪熊啊！我真的就这点出息。9. 王女士：我明天要去开卡丁车！我：你就这点追求？王：你一个为了看电视五分钟洗完澡的人还说我？？干什么？10. “认真是一种美德，可惜人们并不普遍具有。”绝了，和大佬一起做project的感觉太爽了，关键是他/她声音还很好听，还会在讨论完正事后表现出对凡间日常生活的关怀，实乃心系八方。我恨不得天天和人家zoom连线。
samples.translation: #SaltBetweenUs# Lately I've been talking a lot of nonsense, my urge to vent is saturated, mainly because I'm too bored. So I've decided to just ramble under this post from now on, so it won't annoy everyone too much. May ramblings collection: 1. I've improved! Before: I would desperately blame myself if I didn't do something productive in a day. Now: Haha! I'm just trash! 2. It's 2020, when on earth are Zhang Jiwen and Chen Shihui going to get their marriage certificate? Ugh, I've been barking for three years (?) and I'm tired of it! 3. Watched the old 1982 film "My Memories of Old Beijing" yesterday, I loved it so much! Lin Haiyin's original book and all of Cao Wenxuan's novels were my literary enlightenment in childhood, I've probably read them about 10 times. btw, watching one movie a day is my ideal life, forget milk tea, I could even skip meals (actually no). 4. Take the bunny and run～/Thought about leaving～ I've been mentally dancing and singing these two lines in my head while sleeping the past two nights, help! 5. I love summer, even though I constantly want to crawl into the fridge, even though I can get bitten by thirty mosquito bumps in one night. But summer afternoons are truly wonderful! "The sun is intense, the water ripples gentle," plus the noisy cicadas, the whispering fan, or the rumbling when it rains, the smell of soil hitting your face, making someone like me who constantly doubts my own existence feel alive. Thinking carefully, the important people in my life were all met in summer. 6. Want to eat grilled meat. Is there any way to make me not want it? If so, please privately message Jack Ma to receive a gratitude red envelope. 7. Studied the map a bit, found out that after moving to Shanghai, my daily commute will involve walking at least 30 minutes, which means I, who dare not ride the shared bikes, will soon get a free tan! My courage is really as weird as my awkwardness threshold: dare to drive a car, but dare not ride a bike on the street, see a car pass by and go "I'm so scared!", jump off the bike the next second. 8. Daydream

samples.original: 印广门清答“一句佛号”一一敏感问题解答第十七问：请问法师，“一句佛号”念到底，能不能往生？答：要看情况。问：怎么讲？答：一、懂得阿弥陀佛真实义，当下往生，一句不念也往生。如大安法师在《净土宗教程》所说“一念顿超，片言即证”。大安法师宣讲“华严四无碍法界”就是阿弥陀佛真实义。读懂《法华经》与《楞严经》所诠一心三藏之义，当下往生，乃至十地、等觉。如印光大师言“法华奥典，妙冠群经，闻即往生，位齐等觉”。“闻”者，“如是我闻”之“闻”，“觉”义，“佛”义。 “觉”到“阿弥陀”，“佛”到“如是我”。如是我闻即如是我佛！如是我觉！阿弥陀佛即阿弥陀闻！阿弥陀觉！又，门内之耳，曰佛曰觉。不是门外之耳，门外之耳曰听。问：我是问那种传统的嘴巴念佛，一句佛号到底的念佛，能不能往生？答：一、念佛念到风吹不动、雨打不进，也能往生。如孟婆念佛。人说“孟婆，你家着火了”。孟婆说“不管它”，一边念佛不停。人说“孟婆，你儿子落水了”。孟婆说“由他去”，一边念佛不停。这样的念佛很难做到。二、念佛念到功夫成片，如净空法师所说“一天当中，没有一事为自己；二十四小时当中，没有一念不是阿弥陀佛”，肯定往生。这也很难做到。印广问：你能做到吗？答：我不能。有这样的人吗？印广答：有。问：谁？答：机器人。问：这么说，念佛不能往生了？答：这可是你说的。我没说。我只说很难。不过，佛倒是说过。问：佛怎说？答：《楞严经.卷六》文殊菩萨代佛对大势至念佛法门进行辩证“诸行是无常，念性元生灭。因果今殊感，云何获圆通？”意思是：行为举止无常（念佛嘴动是行，是为），念佛之念，其本质是生灭法则（后念起，前念灭……），以生灭之因（念佛是因），求不生灭之果（成佛是果），其差距如此之殊，怎能圆满、圆融、圆通？（怎能往生）不过，真正来讲，只要你认准一句佛号，不停地念下去，也能往生。问：那得多少时间？答：无量劫。问：无量劫？到底有多长？答：不好说了。无量就是无量，没有数哇！你不是说一句佛号到底吗？念就是。如果十法界都往生了，你也一定往生。问：为什么？答：大家都成佛了，你跟谁分别？谁跟你分别？你被他力化掉了。问：也就是说，念佛是最低级的法门了？答：N0！是高级法门。法华、楞严一心三藏才是最低级的法门。是学前班的课本。而念佛等无量法门是高级法门。问：为什么？你不是说《法华经》、《楞严经》是经王吗？答：那是佛说！我没说什么王不王，我只是将佛说，转告大家而已。是转告，述而不作。问：为什么是王，又是最低呢？答：因为它是基础课，是悟前起修的方便法门、引导法门。读懂法华、楞严一心三藏之理，无修无证而当下明心见性，成分真即佛。再经过百千万亿年的悟后进修，广修念佛法门等无量高级法门，不断提升品位成究竟、圆满、一百分的佛。海最低，海纳百川，有容乃大。普天之下莫非王土，率土之滨莫非王臣。因为其低，所以是王！因其最低，所以最高！即低即高，故为圆教！重复提醒：无量法门皆是悟后进修的高级法门、方便法门！不可作为悟前起修的基础法门，方便法门！我们不要辜负佛陀法华大会、楞严大会的谆谆教诲！印广门清2018.3.21#高以翔妈妈##动漫##设计美学##拼多多#

samples.original: 夜思集：①睡觉是人世间最好的馈赠。②55岁阿姨情感分享，只顾眼前珍惜眼前的快乐。当眼前的快乐积累到一定数值时，会慢慢成为永久的快乐。当她和小三岁的初恋在一起时，所有人都不认同且觉得不会长久，可是他们已经恩爱了这么多年。且如酒般醇厚，越爱越深。③医院这个地方，生死场景太多了。水池边闲谈随便几句话就能懂得所有由来，太多遗憾也有太多情感。我对此的定义和理解好像在慢慢加深也在慢慢接受。④我拒绝长大的本质原因是逃避现实，这是别人给我一针见血的回复。深知但宁愿逃避，不愿自己独力是因为觉得累和疲惫。可这就是长大，也因此领悟会更深刻。⑤关于朋友，善意和恶意总是会突然存在的矛盾体。那些说着你要是有什么问题就打电话给我们，反正我们闲大抵是可以交心的人了。因为他们的善意是保留联系，汲取温暖，与之而来的恶意则是满满的“威胁”，我若不打电话随即将我拉黑这种话也是从他们口中而来。⑥太多人说活在当下了，那么如何活在当下。若将生死看淡，一切好像也都失去了创造的意义。可这却给予意义仪式感，你的每一个选择行为和对话都会进入一种“活在当下”的模式中。芜湖#困##夜思集##睡眠是馈赠# 芜湖·弋矶山医院
samples.translation: Night Thoughts Collection: ① Sleep is the best gift in the world. ② A 55-year-old aunt shares her feelings, focusing on cherishing the happiness before her eyes. When the happiness before one's eyes accumulates to a certain amount, it slowly becomes permanent happiness. When she got together with her first love who is three years younger, everyone disapproved and thought it wouldn't last, but they have been deeply in love for so many years. And like wine, it becomes richer and deeper with time. ③ In hospitals, there are too many scenes of life and death. A casual chat by the water fountain can reveal all the origins; there is too much regret and too much emotion. My definition and understanding of this seem to be slowly deepening and slowly accepting. ④ The essential reason I refuse to grow up is to escape reality, which is the blunt reply others gave me. I know it well but would rather escape; I don't want to be independent because I feel tired and exhausted. But this is what growing up is, and because of this, the understanding becomes more profound. ⑤ Regarding friends, kindness and malice always suddenly coexist as contradictions. Those who say "if you have any problems, just call us, we're mostly free anyway" are probably people you can confide in. Because their kindness is to maintain contact and draw warmth, while the accompanying malice is full of "threats"—words like "if you don't call, I'll block you immediately" also come from their mouths. ⑥ Too many people talk about living in the moment, so how does one live in the moment? If you become indifferent to life and death, everything seems to lose its meaning of creation. Yet this gives meaning a sense of ritual; every choice, action, and conversation you make enters a mode of "living in the moment." Wuhu #tired# #Night Thoughts Collection# #Sleep is a Gift# Wuhu · Yijishan Hospital
samples.label: normal

samples.original: #大学快要毕业时是什么感觉# 今天想来聊一聊kavien哥，一个从新浪做技术转型到创业公司做猎头的传奇人物，有过十几年的摇滚经历，非常年轻的容貌配上沉稳的内心，在下很佩服！今天临近下班时候，碰巧有机会再多聊几句，其实还蛮深刻，转型时自己是空杯心态，认识了很多人，多数都是行业tp，敲代码时已经到去药店不知道怎么买药，每天吃喝都在工位，沟通只求简洁高效，所以现在不惧怕回炉重造，其实很多人缺的不是能力，而是这股认定做到底的勇气，所有人包括父母都不支持，但是我觉得我可以试一把！Just to do it！所以 我现在觉得 我也可以再试一把！2020一起加油吧💪#2020 爱你爱你# 北京·西北旺
samples.translation: #What does it feel like when you're about to graduate from college# Today I want to talk about Brother Kavien, a legendary figure who transitioned from technology at Sina to becoming a headhunter at a startup, with over a decade of rock music experience, a very youthful appearance paired with a steady heart—I truly admire him! Just before getting off work today, I happened to have the chance to chat a bit more, and it was quite profound. During his transition, he maintained an empty-cup mindset, met many people, most of whom were industry top performers. When coding, he reached a point where he didn’t even know how to buy medicine at a pharmacy, eating and drinking at his workstation every day, communicating only for brevity and efficiency, so now he isn’t afraid to start over. In fact, what many people lack isn’t ability, but the courage to commit fully. Everyone, including his parents, didn’t support him, but he thought he could give it a try! Just to do it! So now I feel like I can give it another try too! Let’s work hard together in 2020 💪 #2020 Love You Love You# Beijing · Northwest Wang

samples.original: 总记得小时候，或靠在书架上，或坐在地上的看爱情小说，会因为男女主角间的纠葛而揪心。但现在会觉得能有空静下心来看一本自己喜欢的书，实在太难。不止是觉得没有时间，而是觉得连本专业，或者是提高能力的书都还有太多太多，如何安心的捧一本闲书。没时间，这是一个极其不负责任，而我也不屑于口，却又会在心底默默念想的词。说出这个词，仿佛就在说自己有时间一定能干成什么一样可笑。这次回来，发现书店虽缩小了营业范围，却没有倒闭，角落处也有几个闲人捧着本闲书，我也得空翻阅一二，心情甚是美丽。
samples.translation: I always remember when I was a child, leaning against a bookshelf or sitting on the floor reading romance novels, my heart would ache over the entanglements between the male and female leads. But now I feel it's so hard to find the time and peace of mind to read a book I truly enjoy. It's not just about feeling like there's no time; it's that there are still so many books related to my profession or for improving my skills—how can I comfortably pick up a leisure book? "No time" is an extremely irresponsible phrase, one I disdain to say out loud, yet it's something I silently think to myself. Saying it feels as laughable as claiming that if I had time, I could definitely accomplish something. This time when I returned, I found that although the bookstore had reduced its business scope, it hadn't closed down. In the corners, a few idle people were holding leisure books, and I also had a moment to flip through a couple. My mood was quite beautiful.
