samples.original: 有人问我要两个孩子和一个有什么区别？1. 人生计划当中没有两个孩子，觉得一个就很好了。理性考虑，可能还是不会有计划要二胎，意外来临，一切都值得！2. 尤其是今年的这几个月疫情，才觉得家里多个孩子，很热闹，两个都有伴儿，不孤单，多大多小都喜欢伴儿。大的没意思了小的玩儿，小的黏着大的。3. 要说经济上多一个肯定花费也跟着增多，但是绝对促进爸爸妈妈的赚钱欲望，会花很多心思考虑怎么不降低生活质量多赚钱。一直的教育理念是拼劲全力给你们生活的必需品，而不是附带品，奢侈品，一定要自己有能力养活自己，不能有依赖思想。4. 不图养儿防老，但想想老了两个比一个热闹。5. 一直到现在更是接受各种各样的生活方式，一个人生活也好，两个人也罢，适合的就是最好的，没有固定模式。但是鉴于他的家庭情况，有两个孩子家里热闹，让家里再增添一份烟火气，也是我对他的心意吧。#成长##二胎##家庭##生活的模样##育儿##一起家庭教育##宝妈分享##亲子教育#
samples.translation: Someone asked me what's the difference between having two children and one? 1. There were no two children in my life plan; I thought one was just fine. Rationally, I probably still wouldn't plan for a second child, but when an unexpected one comes, everything is worth it! 2. Especially during the pandemic months this year, I realized having an extra child at home makes it lively. Both have a companion and aren't lonely; everyone likes company, big or small. When the older one gets bored, they play with the younger one; the younger one sticks to the older one. 3. Financially, one more child definitely increases expenses, but it absolutely boosts Mom and Dad's desire to earn money. We'll put a lot of thought into how to earn more without lowering our quality of life. Our consistent parenting philosophy is to strive our hardest to provide you with life's necessities, not extras or luxuries. You must be capable of supporting yourselves and not have a dependent mindset. 4. I don't expect to raise children for old-age support, but I think two will be livelier than one when we're old. 5. Up to now, I've come to accept all kinds of lifestyles. Living alone is fine, living as a couple is fine too; what suits you is best, there's no fixed model. But given his family situation, having two children makes the home lively, adding another touch of life's warmth to the household, which is also my sentiment towards him. #Growth##SecondChild##Family##TheLookOfLife##Parenting##FamilyEducationTogether##MomSharing##ParentChildEducation#

samples.original: 大乘妙法莲华经⚛︎ 虚空也是由我们的心变化出来的。你不能讲它销亡，也不能讲它不销亡，我们要现就现，要销就销。在世间法来讲，虚空不可以销亡，谁也不能咬他一口，谁也不能踢他一脚，是不是？后面讲的「舜若多神」，众生位如果讨厌有形有相的肉团身，想要证虚空身，那就是虚空神。他有个灵体在这里，没有形相，可他就是在！所以舜若多性呢，我们把它分开区别。还有个「虚空藏菩萨」，那是菩萨在读懂了《法华经》《楞严经》，明心见性以后，他也跟虚空神一样证得虚空身，外形都是一样，可是里面境界不一样。舜若多神他证到虚空身也是福报啊，他不受苦了！他福报满了以后还要往下落，所以舜若多神是有福报的鬼王之类的。但虚空藏菩萨他只会往上升，究竟成佛！他不会往下落。四空天的天人也可以视为舜若多神、天神。「烁迦罗」翻译成汉语是「坚固」的意思。「烁迦罗心无动转」，我坚固的菩提心不会动摇！~宋清芳诗歌#世界佛法##佛学大智慧#  宋清芳卍山西朔州的微博视频#诗词##海报##哔哩哔哩动画##蔡徐坤#
samples.translation: The Great Vehicle Wonderful Dharma Lotus Sutra⚛︎ Emptiness is also manifested from our mind. You cannot say it vanishes, nor can you say it does not vanish; it appears when we want it to appear and vanishes when we want it to vanish. In terms of worldly dharma, emptiness cannot vanish; no one can bite it, no one can kick it, right? Later, it mentions "舜若多神" (Śūnyatā deities): if sentient beings dislike the tangible, physical flesh body and wish to realize the emptiness body, that is the emptiness deity. It has a spiritual entity here, without form, yet it exists! So regarding the nature of Śūnyatā, we differentiate it. There is also "虚空藏菩萨" (Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva), who, after comprehending the Lotus Sutra and the Śūraṅgama Sutra, realizing the mind and seeing the nature, also attains the emptiness body like the emptiness deity. Their external forms are the same, but their inner realms differ. The Śūnyatā deity attaining the emptiness body is also due to merit; it no longer suffers! After its merit is exhausted, it will still fall, so the Śūnyatā deity is a kind of ghost king with merit. But Ākāśagarbha Bodhisattva only ascends, ultimately attaining Buddhahood! It will not fall. The deities of the Four Formless Heavens can also be considered Śūnyatā deities, celestial beings. "烁迦罗" translates to "firm" in Chinese. "烁迦罗心无动转", my firm bodhi mind will not waver! ~ Song Qingfang Poetry #WorldBuddhism##BuddhistWisdom# Song Qingfang 卍 Shanxi Shuozhou Weibo Video #Poetry##Poster##Bilibili Animation##Cai Xukun#

samples.original: 片言即证——法海淘宝39￼ 搜孤救孤10小时前 · 大连观海文化传播有限公司董事长 教育领域创作者六方佛护——法海淘宝39玄机之二:“广长舌相”“各于其国，出广长舌相，遍覆三千大千世界，说诚实言”。(一)、俗谛质疑:1、佛舌遍覆大千，遮天蔽日，是何景观？2、有以“文殊三世不打诳语，舌可覆面”而作衬解。不禁要问，这大舌头，云何藏于蛋大之口？云何嚼食咽汤？云何利索言语？3、如是“说诚实言”，云何令人信解？诚服？(二)、真谛探索:1、“各于其国”者，世界、宇宙、万物，宏大至天地，细微至发梢，乃至邻虚尘……无非法身真常！无非报化妙用！个个堪称其国！当由、当人、当事、当处、当时、迷悟之分！确确实实、真真切切、并无本质之别！所谓本真自真，何待他求！所谓虚妄本妄，何待破除！是为“说诚实言”！2、“出广长舌”者，当人自性佛菩，虽名本具，不经来人指点，亦如衣裹明珠，不得真实妙用。是故，自觉觉他，布道度人，实乃佛菩利他天责！又当觉时，觉于万法。杂色奇鸟无非“和雅之韵”！众宝行树岂不“微妙之音”？乃至行云流水无非“广长舌相”！所谓“百草头上祖师意，溪水无非广长舌”！众生各以同分妄见，不见自他共性！唯以别业妄见，枉自于异己受报！感慨:望文生义，三世佛冤！既辜佛陀良苦用心！亦负众生法身慧命！难怪众生不信佛啊！难怪众生难信佛啊！皆因“用世语言，入佛知见……但有言说，俱无实义”(《楞严经·卷三、四》)2019.10.27(下期预告:不可思议)              🌸 #佛##佛教##佛法看世间##推文##亚洲好书榜##智慧语录##法师开示##我在未来等你##佛学常识##情感语录#陈立农#熊猫守护者#
samples.translation: A Single Phrase as Proof - Fahai Taobao 39. The Mystery of the Six Directions Buddha Protection - Fahai Taobao 39 Part Two: "The Broad and Long Tongue Mark" "Each in his own land, manifests the broad and long tongue mark, covering the three thousand great thousand worlds, speaking truthful words." (I) Conventional Truth Inquiry: 1. The Buddha's tongue covers the great thousand, obscuring the sky and sun—what kind of sight is that? 2. Some use "Manjusri, throughout three lifetimes, never speaks falsely; his tongue can cover his face" as a comparative explanation. One cannot help but ask: How can such a large tongue be hidden in a mouth the size of an egg? How can it chew food and swallow soup? How can it speak fluently? 3. Speaking such "truthful words," how can they make people believe and understand? Sincerely submit? (II) Ultimate Truth Exploration: 1. "Each in his own land" refers to the world, the universe, all things, vast as heaven and earth, minute as a hair's tip, even to the smallest particle... all are nothing but the Dharma-body's true constancy! All are nothing but the wonderful function of reward and transformation! Each can be called its own land! It depends on the distinction between delusion and enlightenment in the situation, the person, the matter, the place, and the time! Truly, really, genuinely, there is no essential difference! So-called fundamental truth is self-truth, why seek elsewhere! So-called falsehood is inherently false, why need to eliminate it! This is "speaking truthful words"! 2. "Manifests the broad and long tongue" refers to the self-nature Buddha and Bodhisattva within each person. Although called inherently possessed, without guidance from a coming one, it is like a pearl wrapped in clothing, unable to attain true wonderful function. Therefore, self-enlightenment and enlightening others, preaching and liberating people, are truly the heavenly duty of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas to benefit others! Furthermore, at the moment of enlightenment, one is enlightened to all dharmas. Variegated strange birds are nothing but "harmonious and elegant melodies"! Jeweled rows of trees are surely "subtle and wonderful sounds"! Even flowing clouds and running water are nothing but the "broad and long tongue mark"

samples.original: 石头城位于江苏省南京市鼓楼区，是一处六朝时期的著名遗迹，遗址位于现清凉山一带，有“东吴第一军事要塞”之称。它扼守秦淮河与长江的交汇口，“因山以为城，因江以为池，地形险固，尤有奇势”，是保障建康城西部安全的军事重镇，也是六朝时期兵家必争之地。南京民间中有关鬼脸城的传说很多。相传这块岩石原来犹如刀削一般，光滑如境。如今在鬼脸城西侧确有一处清亮的池塘，从水面的一侧可以看到鬼脸城的倒影，老南京人俗称之为“鬼脸照镜子”。
samples.translation: Shitoucheng, located in the Gulou District of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province, is a famous relic from the Six Dynasties period. The site is situated in the present-day Qingliang Mountain area and is known as the "First Military Fortress of Eastern Wu." It guards the confluence of the Qinhuai River and the Yangtze River. "Using the mountain as a wall and the river as a moat, the terrain is perilously solid and uniquely strategic." It served as a crucial military stronghold protecting the western security of Jiankang City and was a contested strategic point during the Six Dynasties period. There are many folk legends in Nanjing about the "Ghost Face City." It is said that the rock was originally as smooth as a mirror, as if cut by a knife. Today, there is indeed a clear pond on the west side of Ghost Face City, where the reflection of Ghost Face City can be seen from one side of the water surface. Old Nanjing residents commonly refer to this as "Ghost Face Looking in the Mirror."

samples.original: 【泡脚最佳水温】许多人觉得只要在自己的承受范围内，水温自然是越高越好，其实并不然。泡脚的最佳水温在50℃以下，要求热而不烫，感受水温不要用手去测量，最好就是用脚去感受。水温过高脚上的血管容易过度扩张，体内血液更多地流向下肢，引起心、脑、肾等重要器官供血不足。
samples.translation: [Best Water Temperature for Foot Soaking] Many people think that as long as it's within their tolerance, the hotter the water, the better—but that's actually not true. The optimal water temperature for foot soaking is below 50°C; it should feel hot but not scalding. Don't test the temperature with your hand; it's best to use your foot to gauge it. If the water is too hot, the blood vessels in your feet can over-dilate, causing more blood to flow to the lower limbs and reducing blood supply to vital organs like the heart, brain, and kidneys.

samples.original: 杨幂#杨幂粉丝#我不是在她爆火的时候认识的她，出演宫的时候我甚至还不认识她，也没有看这部剧，当然更没有开始了解娱乐圈。我不是因为她有多火多厉害而粉的她，我最初就仅仅是心疼这个女孩而爱上了她。初二那年无意间看见了她的个人资料和一些经历，真的觉得这个女孩很努力，努力的让人心疼。然后我就开始关注她，发现她真的有在发光哦~ 和别人也都是很骄傲的说我是杨幂的粉丝！！ 她做到了啊，不会让我们觉得成为她的粉丝是件丢脸的事。我现在大二了，是粉幂的第七年。我是很佛系的粉丝，没有做过什么数据，打榜也很少。我就经常关注幂幂的作品，支持她的电视剧电影，看看她的采访啊综艺之类的，买买周边这种。我作为蜜蜂中的小小只，我不觉得我真正为我杨幂做了些什么。相反，我粉她的过程中，自己倒是收获了不少。因为她，我开始关注各种各样的公益，也努力像她一样去传递温暖。幂幂真的给了我满满的正能量啊，我也开始学着努力去坚持。每次想放弃的时候，想想幂就又元气满满了。难过的时候，看看幂幂的月牙笑，心情也真的会突然变好啊(呜呜呜笑起来也太甜太可爱太好看了8) 现在也是，我只要看见幂的脸，我就开心啊。幂真的超级可爱呢，超级想抱抱她。我们幂也真的很优秀啊，长得还那么好看又努力上进，还关心粉丝，也超有梗，还很敬业。作为粉丝的话，杨幂幸福就是最开心的事啦。无论什么时候，我都希望我们小幂做她自己，开心就好。下个十年，我还在。晚安，蜜蜂们~ 晚安，我的宝贝@杨幂
samples.translation: Yang Mi #YangMiFans# I didn't know her when she became explosively popular. When she starred in "Palace", I didn't even know her, nor did I watch that drama, and of course, I hadn't started learning about the entertainment industry yet. I didn't become her fan because of how popular or amazing she is; initially, I just fell in love with her because I felt sorry for this girl. In my second year of junior high, I accidentally saw her personal profile and some of her experiences, and I really thought this girl worked so hard, so hard it was heartbreaking. Then I started paying attention to her and discovered she really shines~ And I proudly tell others I'm Yang Mi's fan!! She made it happen; she doesn't make us feel embarrassed about being her fans. I'm now a sophomore in college, my seventh year being a Mi fan. I'm a very laid-back fan; I haven't done any data work, and I rarely participate in voting. I often follow Mi Mi's works, support her TV shows and movies, watch her interviews and variety shows, and buy merchandise and such. As a tiny bee in the hive, I don't feel I've really done anything for my Yang Mi. On the contrary, during the time I've been her fan, I've gained a lot myself. Because of her, I started paying attention to various charitable causes and strive to spread warmth like she does. Mi Mi really gives me so much positive energy, and I've also started learning to persevere. Whenever I want to give up, thinking of Mi fills me with energy again. When I'm sad, looking at Mi Mi's crescent-moon smile really suddenly makes my mood better (sob, her smile is too sweet, cute, and beautiful). Even now, just seeing Mi's face makes me happy. Mi is really super cute; I really want to hug her. Our Mi is also really outstanding, so beautiful yet hardworking and driven, cares about her fans, is super witty, and very dedicated to her work. As a fan, Yang Mi's happiness is the happiest thing. No matter what, I always hope our little Mi stays true to herself and is happy. Next decade, I'll still be here. Goodnight, bees~ Goodnight, my baby @Yang Mi

samples.original: #育儿分享# 今天周一儿子要去上幼儿园，他又开始不想去了，这实在太正常了，因为家里有爱他的爸爸妈妈、家里很温暖、有电视看、有手机玩、有零食吃、家里哪哪都熟悉，可是幼儿园不一样幼儿园陌生、小朋友陌生、老师陌生他没有掌控感，他需要适应、需要熟悉、是要有一个过程的，这个过程就是在幼儿园有不断的问题需要他去应对，解决问题之后的成就感就是自己给的，这就是成长。家里有家里的好，幼儿园有幼儿园的好，而我们父母要做的就是坚定，而父母的这种坚定的力量就会成为他的勇气，他需要父母坚定的力量推他一把。如果哭闹就可以妥协，可能未来的目标就是有这种怕的心里，就是这么一念之差就失之交臂了，只是在这个时候坚定一下就成了。我抱着儿子说你不想去幼儿园你哭的话爸爸会打你这我管不了，妈妈不会打你妈妈都理解你理解你想妈妈爸爸、想家，可是爸爸妈妈的共同目标就是今天你必须去幼儿园。后来我儿子终于想去幼儿园了，是因为他想给小朋友看他的一个小玩具，就像是去幼儿园有了一个自己想要达成的目标，有了这个目标就有了他想去的动力。
samples.translation: #ParentingShare# Monday today, my son has to go to kindergarten, and he started not wanting to go again. This is completely normal because at home there are parents who love him, it's warm, there's TV to watch, phones to play with, snacks to eat, and everything is familiar. But kindergarten is different—it's unfamiliar, the kids are unfamiliar, the teachers are unfamiliar, he has no sense of control. He needs to adapt, to get familiar, it's a process. This process means there are constant problems at kindergarten he needs to handle, and the sense of achievement after solving them is his own—that's growth. Home has its good points, kindergarten has its good points, and what we parents need to do is be firm. This firmness from parents becomes his courage; he needs that firm push from his parents. If we compromise because of crying, maybe future goals will be met with this kind of fear, and it's just a narrow miss because of that one thought—it just takes being firm at this moment. I held my son and said, "If you don't want to go to kindergarten and cry, Dad might hit you, I can't control that. Mom won't hit you; Mom understands you, understands that you miss Mom and Dad, miss home. But our common goal as parents is that you must go to kindergarten today." samples.original: 虞书欣 🎂#虞书欣1218生日快乐# 虞书欣  生日快乐🎂🎊12.18一个特殊的日子，我的女孩降临在了这个世界。很多人都知道她出生家境优越，可她从小就被父母穷养，没有零花钱，不敢跟父母要很贵的东西，后来班里同学有背很好看的包包，她也想要，父母不给她买后来她想当偶像，但是父母想让她继承家产，告诉她：“如果你28岁之前出不了名，就回来继承家业”她——去做了"一年级"里的你因为“作”被很多人骂，但你一直很乐观，那是我第一次认识你下一站是幸福里的蔡敏敏古灵精怪，你饰演女二，记得有段剧情男女主很虐，是女二和男二支撑着我看下去，后来我比起主角，更喜欢这一对，那是我第一次喜欢你那天上午阳光正好，我躺在床上打开aqy，不知道看什么，却刷到了“少主且慢行”那是第一天上线，虞书欣演的古装剧，我从来不看古装剧，但是那一次我看到了你，我就想要尝试，我点了进去，里面的剧情太吸我了，那是我第一次喜欢古装剧，那一天我躺在床上追了一天的剧，追到了晚上……看到最后那个抢亲唱歌的地方，我居然哭了，我知道我看电视剧从来不哭，许多大事我都不会哭，但不知道为什么那一次我哭了，我也很奇怪，因为那部剧真的太好了！真的是我有史以来最喜欢的一部剧，我看完立马就去二刷了，那是我开始决定追你的第一次后来我知道你要去参加青春有你2，我很吃惊，我超级高兴的为你加油，一定要送你C位出道，开播的那天，并没有那么好。因为说话作作的，被骂上了热搜第一，那一天晚上真的真的很伤心，很累，一直在忙，反黑，超话，发稿，安利后来你的“哇偶”吸粉无数，很多人都真香打脸，你很可爱很真实初舞台的“爱你”火了很久，后来你的一个个舞台，你次次举动和镜头，粉丝渐渐多了起来，我叫着很多朋友，帮忙每天投票，🍊的时候也少不了我最终第二出道，那时有很多争议，你依然很开心，然后就接了越来越多的广告和综艺，越来越忙，但是你每次在镜头前都能给我们带来快乐，我很骄傲我喜欢的人是你宝贝希望你永远开心快乐，不止生日一定要在你所热爱的世界里闪闪发亮✨虞书欣   生日快乐。🎊🎂                                                 ——12.12lgc
samples.translation: Yu Shuxin 🎂#HappyBirthdayToYuShuxin1218# Yu Shuxin, happy birthday 🎂🎊 December 18th, a special day, my girl came into this world. Many people know she was born into a wealthy family, but she was raised frugally by her parents since childhood, had no pocket money, and didn't dare ask for expensive things. Later, when classmates had really nice backpacks, she wanted one too, but her parents wouldn't buy it for her. Then she wanted to become an idol, but her parents wanted her to inherit the family business and told her: "If you don't become famous by age 28, come back and inherit the family enterprise." She—went and did it. In "Freshman Year," you were criticized by many for being "annoying," but you always stayed optimistic; that was my first time knowing you. Cai Minmin in "The Next Happiness" was quirky and clever; you played the second female lead. I remember a plot where the main couple was very angsty, and it was the second couple that kept me watching. Later, I preferred that pair over the main leads; that was my first time liking you. That morning, the sunlight was just right, I lay in bed and opened iQiyi, not knowing what to watch, but then I came across "The Untamed" on its first day of release—a historical drama starring Yu Shuxin. I never watch historical dramas, but that time I saw you and wanted to give it a try. I clicked in, and the plot completely drew me in. That was my first time liking a historical drama; that day I lay in bed binge-watching all day, into the night... When I reached the part about snatching the bride and singing, I actually cried. I know I never cry watching TV shows, and I don't cry over many big things, but I don't know why I cried that time; I found it strange too, because that drama was just so good! It's truly my favorite drama ever; I finished it and immediately rewatched it. That was the first time I decided to follow you. Later, I learned you were going to join "Youth With You 2"; I was surprised and super happy, cheering you on, determined to help you debut as center. The day it aired wasn't so great. Because of your "annoying" way

samples.original: 连续闷热了好几天，南京终于在今天迎来了一场属于盛夏的暴雨。放假已经好几天了，撑着伞走出G组团的时候，眼帘里除了漫天的雨只有寥寥几个行人，也同样撑着形形色色的伞沿着马路走向自己的目的地。我还是选择从两旁种满榉树的那条道路走向我自己的目的地。每次走这条路我都怀抱着一种莫名的情感，不论是晴天还是下雨天，也不论是冬天还是夏天，它好像都有自己独特的样子。两旁的榉树长得又高又直，随性生长的纤细枝叶在马路中央的上空汇合，春天会冒出很浅很浅的绿色的叶子，到了夏天浅绿色会慢慢变得更深，就好像被盛夏的阳光晒得老化了一样，秋天开始掉叶子，所以冬天的时候抬头只能看见光秃秃的树枝了，幕布是灰沉沉的天空。四季流转里，只有来来往往的同学陪着这些树，以及两旁的红墙与河水。今天终于是有暴雨的日子了，马路上不再是一成不变的树荫轮廓，而是稀里哗啦的小水流。因为没有人，所以我肆无忌惮地踩着中线一步一步地走，溅得自己满脚满裤子的水也毫不在意，急速降落在我的伞面的雨水又顺着脊线下落，为我隔出一个朦胧胧的小世界。在我的记忆里，每一个盛夏都应该有一场说来就来的暴雨的，即使把所有的门窗都关好，还是听得见屋外水花四溅的声音，所有的乌云遮蔽了天空，所以室内也是一片昏暗。等到暴雨停歇，就可以见到被雨洗过的天空，被雨洗过的空气，被雨洗过的叶子……被雨洗过的一切，连夏日的暑气都被清洗一空，轻轻地嗅一嗅，还能闻到未消散完的涩涩的雨水的味道啊。这场雨所有的水如果没有来得及挥发一空的话，会顺着蜿蜒的道路一直汇聚到长江，最后奔流入海。所有天上来的精灵，最后都会回到大海的怀抱里，这样一想，好像有点浪漫的样子❤ 南京·中国药科大学(江宁校区)
samples.translation: After several consecutive days of sweltering heat, Nanjing finally welcomed a summer downpour today. It's been several days since the holiday began. When I walked out of Building G with an umbrella, my view held nothing but the sweeping rain and a few scattered pedestrians, also holding various umbrellas, walking along the road toward their destinations. I still chose to walk toward my own destination via the road lined with zelkova trees. Every time I take this road, I'm filled with an inexplicable emotion. Whether it's sunny or rainy, winter or summer, it seems to have its own unique appearance. The zelkova trees on both sides grow tall and straight, their freely growing slender branches and leaves meeting overhead in the middle of the road. In spring, very pale green leaves emerge. By summer, the light green slowly deepens, as if aged by the midsummer sun. Leaves begin to fall in autumn, so in winter, looking up, you only see bare branches against the backdrop of a gloomy, gray sky. Through the changing seasons, only the coming and going students accompany these trees, along with the red walls and the river on either side. Today finally brought the heavy rain. The road was no longer a monotonous silhouette of tree shade but filled with the sound of rushing little streams. Because there was no one around, I walked unabashedly down the center line, step by step, not minding the water splashing all over my feet and pants. The rain rapidly landing on my umbrella flowed down the spine, creating a hazy little world around me. In my memory, every midsummer should have a sudden, heavy downpour. Even with all the doors and windows closed, you can still hear the sound of water splashing outside. All the dark clouds blot out the sky, so the indoors are dim too. When the rain stops, you can see the rain-washed sky, the rain-washed air, the rain-washed leaves... everything washed by the rain, even the summer heat cleansed away. Take a gentle sniff, and you can still smell the lingering, astringent scent of the rain. If all the water from this rain doesn't evaporate in time, it will flow along the winding roads, eventually converging into the Yangtze River and rushing out to sea. All the spirits from the sky eventually return to the embrace of the sea. Thinking of it this way seems a bit romantic ❤ Nanjing · China Pharmaceutical University (Jiangning

samples.original: 最看不惯发生任何事情就上升到国家的人。14亿人什么样的变态不会出现，林子大了什么样的鸟不会有。如果国家在每个人体内植入芯片24小时监视，这些人一样还是跳脚吐口水的人。不是说国家没错，最大的错我觉得是判刑太轻犯罪成本低，但是国家才成立70年，它才70岁，它还需要时间一点一点摸索前进。生活中我也遇到很多黑暗（警察收保护费抓走我的家人都遇到过），但是我一直相信这只是因为哪个行业都有坏人，但是国家，是在进步的。有时候觉得人真的安逸久了就变了，才几年的时间，抗日战争时的热血为国英勇无畏就基本见不到了，剩下的只有自己能得到多少福利，只有拿国家跟世界所有国家美好一面的对比，只有一句调侃，“你国不行”。
samples.translation: I can't stand people who escalate everything to the level of the nation. With 1.4 billion people, what kind of perverts wouldn't appear? In a big forest, all kinds of birds exist. Even if the state implanted chips in everyone for 24-hour surveillance, these same people would still be the ones stomping and spitting. It's not that the state is without fault—the biggest mistake, I think, is that sentencing is too lenient and the cost of crime is too low. But the country has only been established for 70 years; it's only 70 years old. It still needs time to grope its way forward bit by bit. In life, I've also encountered much darkness (I've experienced police collecting protection fees and having my family arrested), but I've always believed this is just because every profession has bad people, but the country is progressing. Sometimes I feel people really change after being comfortable for too long. In just a few years, the passionate, brave, fearless patriotism of the War of Resistance era has basically vanished. What remains is only how much welfare one can get, only comparing the country to the best aspects of all nations worldwide, only a mocking phrase: "Your country sucks."

samples.original: 《平庸》十三是猪圈中众多只猪的一只，不过他是最瘦小的一只，小时候吃奶，它得等到前面的十二猪吃完了才能吃，却没剩多少奶，长大了，猪饲料也吃兄弟姐妹剩下的。它觉得自己平庸的很过分。就做了一个梦，梦里有个老神仙，给了它一株仙草，告诉它吃完了就会变大变胖，成为猪界美男，神草是靠意志生长，你心里想变多大就能变多大。十三受够了这么碌碌无为的活着，如果能一夜暴胖，它死了都愿意。梦想成真，它变成了胖十三，比它妈妈都要胖两圈，主人大喜给它换了一个豪华套房，好吃好喝供着它，它突然有种农奴翻身做地主的快感。只是日子久了，它有点孤单，毕竟无敌是那么寂寞。好久不长，它已经胖到行动都困难了，也长不了多少肉了。其实胖瘦都逃不过被杀的命运。刽子手磨着刀说，这是他见过最肥的猪。十三很自豪它是猪界之最，不过听着磨刀霍霍的声音，它还是怂了。它想回到最初，和兄弟姐妹一起抢食的日子，它不想变得一株惊人，它就变成一只普通猪就行，让时间慢一点在慢一点吧。一鞭子主人把它抽醒了，嘴上骂道:就你不争气，养了这么久就你最瘦。果然是黄粱一梦。它又开心起来，扑腾扑腾在兄弟姐中妹磨蹭抢食，却也抢不到。人跟猪一样总是追求自己得不到的，殊不知此时拥有平庸已是最大的幸福。不是说追求变好不对，而是无论人处的位置高低，美丑富穷，都能不以物喜，不以己悲，心安理得最重要。
samples.translation: "Mediocrity" Thirteen was one of many pigs in the pigsty, but he was the skinniest one. As a piglet nursing, he had to wait until the first twelve pigs finished before he could nurse, leaving little milk left. Growing up, he also ate the leftover feed from his siblings. He felt his mediocrity was excessive. So he had a dream where an old immortal gave him a magical herb, telling him that after eating it he would grow big and fat, becoming a handsome male in the pig world. The herb grew through willpower—it would grow as big as he wished in his heart. Thirteen was tired of living such an unremarkable life; if he could become fat overnight, he would be willing to die for it. The dream came true: he became Fat Thirteen, two sizes fatter than his mother. The owner was overjoyed and moved him to a luxurious suite, pampering him with good food and drink. Suddenly, he felt the thrill of a slave turning into a landlord. But as time passed, he grew a bit lonely—after all, being invincible is so isolating. Not long after, he had grown so fat that movement became difficult, and he couldn't gain much more weight. In truth, whether fat or thin, all pigs cannot escape the fate of being slaughtered. The butcher sharpened his knife, saying this was the fattest pig he had ever seen. Thirteen was proud to be the best in the pig world, but hearing the sound of the sharpening knife, he still felt scared. He wanted to return to the beginning, to the days of scrambling for food with his siblings. He didn't want to be shockingly outstanding; he just wanted to be an ordinary pig, wishing time would slow down, slower and slower. A whip from the owner woke him up, cursing: "You're the one who's useless—after raising you for so long, you're still the skinniest." It was indeed a pipe dream. He became happy again, bustling among his siblings, rubbing against them and scrambling for food, yet still unable to get any. Humans, like pigs, always pursue what they cannot have, unaware that the mediocrity they possess at this moment is already the greatest happiness. It's not that striving to improve is wrong, but rather that regardless of one's position—high or low, beautiful or ugly, rich or poor—one should not be overly joyful or sorrowful over

samples.original: 半夜睡觉突然想起来，好小好小时候午睡妈妈会看着时间差不多了，蹲在床边拿着零食哄我起床，我记得她笑着的弯弯的眼睛，还记得她轻声的叫我幺儿，这种确切的实在的被人宠爱的感觉真的很好很想念，可是我从两三岁变成现在的二十三岁，好像除了那次，再也记不得别的类似的感受了。父母老去和我的长大似乎都让人变得不善于表达我们内心的爱意吧，我当然知道'这种爱意不表达不是因为她不存在，是大家都觉得这是理所应当的事情何必去说，我不好意思，羞于开口，当然别人也能这样。我是被爱着的。明天给妈妈打电话多聊聊吧，拖延到最后的论文也感觉写掉，晚安
samples.translation: In the middle of the night, I suddenly remembered when I was very, very young, my mother would watch the time during my nap, squat by the bed with snacks to coax me awake. I remember her smiling, crescent-shaped eyes and her softly calling me 'darling.' That certain, tangible feeling of being cherished was truly wonderful and I miss it. But from age two or three to now at twenty-three, aside from that time, I can't recall any other similar feelings. Parents aging and me growing up seem to have made us all less adept at expressing the love in our hearts. Of course I know 'this love isn't expressed not because it doesn't exist, but because everyone takes it for granted, so why mention it?' I feel awkward, too shy to say it, and of course others feel the same. I am loved. I'll call my mom tomorrow and chat more. I'll also finish the paper I've been procrastinating on until the last minute. Goodnight.
